title.zh: 耶利哥成为最早的大型定居点

summary.zh: 约公元前9000年，黎凡特地区的耶利哥（今巴勒斯坦地区）发展成为已知最早的大型定居点之一，面积约4公顷，人口约2000人。居民从事早期农业（种植大麦和小麦）和贸易（从安纳托利亚输入黑曜石）。约公元前8300-8000年，居民用石块修建了厚约2米的防御城墙和圆形石塔（高约8.5米），表明早期社会组织已具备集体劳动和防御能力。

title.zh: 内瓦利乔里神庙建筑群建造

summary.zh: 约公元前8400年，安纳托利亚东南部（今土耳其尚勒乌尔法省）的内瓦利乔里（Nevalı Çori）遗址开始建造纪念性建筑群。该遗址与哥贝克力石阵同期，出土有T形石柱和巨型石雕人像（高约2米），石柱上雕刻有蛇、蝎子等动物图案。遗址还发现了早期农业证据（种植单粒小麦），表明祭祀活动与早期农业社区密切相关。

title.zh: 艾因加扎勒雕像群制作

summary.zh: 约公元前8200-7500年，黎凡特地区（今约旦安曼附近）的艾因加扎勒（'Ain Ghazal）遗址制作了多尊真人大小的人形石膏雕像，现存于安曼博物馆。这些雕像是已知最早的大型人形雕像之一，眼睛用沥青描绘，身体为石膏覆盖芦苇骨架。该遗址面积约15公顷，人口约3000人，是前陶新石器时代C期最大的定居点之一，从事农业和贸易。

title.zh: 耶利哥城墙与石塔建成

summary.zh: 约公元前8000年，耶利哥居民修建了环绕定居点的石砌城墙（厚约2米）和一座高约8.5米的圆形石塔（内设楼梯）。这是世界上已知最早的防御性城防建筑，表明前陶新石器时代（PPNA）的社会组织已具备动员大批劳动力进行公共工程建设的能力。

summary.zh: 澳洲原住民自数万年前起在岩壁作画，题材为动物、精灵与创世图腾，是世界上最古老且延续至今的艺术传统之一，北领地的金伯利与阿纳姆地岩画尤为著名。

title.zh: 中国彭头山文化驯化水稻

summary.zh: 约公元前8000-7500年，长江中游的彭头山文化（今湖南澧县）出现了世界上最早的水稻驯化证据之一，遗址中发现炭化稻谷和稻叶印痕。彭头山先民已定居建村，使用红陶器和磨制石器，从事稻作农业和渔猎采集。彭头山文化表明长江流域是世界稻作农业的重要起源地之一。

statement.zh: 约公元前8000-7500年，长江中游的彭头山文化（今湖南澧县）出现了世界上最早的水稻驯化证据之一，遗址中发现炭化稻谷和稻叶印痕。
statement.en: Around 8000-7500 BCE, the Pengtoushan culture (modern Li County, Hunan) in the middle Yangtze River valley produced one of the world's earliest pieces of evidence for rice domestication, with carbonized rice grains and rice leaf impressions found at the site.

title.zh: 塞浦路斯早期农业定居

summary.zh: 约公元前7950年，来自安纳托利亚和黎凡特的移民在塞浦路斯岛建立早期农业定居点（如基罗基蒂亚/Khirokitia）。居民种植大麦和小麦，饲养绵羊、山羊和猪，使用石制工具。塞浦路斯是地中海最早被殖民的大岛之一，其早期定居证明了新石器时代人类已具备一定航海能力。基罗基蒂亚的圆形石屋建筑是其典型特征。

statement.en: Around 7950 BCE, migrants from Anatolia and the Levant established early agricultural settlements on the island of Cyprus (e.g., Khirokitia).

summary.zh: 约公元前7400-6200年，安纳托利亚高原的恰塔尔霍尤克（今土耳其科尼亚省）达到繁荣期，成为新石器时代最大的定居点之一（约13公顷，巅峰人口约5000-8000人）。房屋密集排列，无街道，通过屋顶出入。居民从事农业（小麦、大麦）、畜牧业和贸易，使用黑曜石制作工具和镜子，壁画和母神雕像反映了丰富的宗教生活。

summary.zh: 美索不达米亚上游约前7400年起驯养牛，畜牧与农耕并行，推动食物生产经济在西亚的扩展与村落的稳定。

statement.zh:
美索不达米亚上游约前7400年起驯养牛，畜牧与农耕并行，推动食物生产经济在西亚的扩展与村落的稳定。牛用于耕犁、运输与乳肉供给，畜力提高了耕作效率，也使农户可以经营更大面积的土地。家畜与作物的组合逐渐形成稳定的农业体系。

把「上美索不达米亚驯牛」放回公元前7400年的美索不达米亚，可以看到农业变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Cattle were domesticated in upper Mesopotamia starting around 7400 BCE, and animal husbandry and farming went hand in hand, promoting the expansion of the food production economy and the stability of villages in West Asia.

title.zh: 中国贾湖文化出现刻画符号

summary.zh: 约公元前7000-5800年，黄河中游的贾湖文化（今河南舞阳）出现了刻画在龟甲、骨器和石器上的符号，共发现17个刻画符号，其中个别符号与后来的商代甲骨文相似。贾湖人已种植水稻、饲养家猪、酿酒（发现世界上最早的酒类残留物），并使用七孔骨笛（已知最早的乐器）。贾湖刻画符号被认为是中国文字起源的重要源头之一。

statement.zh: 约公元前7000-5800年，黄河中游的贾湖文化（今河南舞阳）出现了刻画在龟甲、骨器和石器上的符号，共发现17个刻画符号，其中个别符号与后来的商代甲骨文相似。贾湖人已种植水稻、饲养家猪、酿酒（发现世界上最早的酒类残留物），并使用七孔骨笛（已知最早的乐器）。贾湖刻画符号被认为是中国文字起源的重要源头之一。
statement.en:
Around 7000-5800 BCE, the Jiahu culture (modern Wuyang, Henan) in the middle Yellow River valley produced symbols inscribed on tortoise shells, bones, and stone tools. Seventeen inscribed symbols were found, some of which resemble later Shang oracle bone script. The Jiahu people cultivated rice, raised pigs, brewed wine (the earliest wine residue in the world), and used seven-hole bone flutes (the earliest known musical instruments). The Jiahu symbols are considered an important origin of Chinese writing.

For Asia in 7000 BCE, “Jiahu culture inscribed symbols in China” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 哈奇拉尔遗址新石器时代聚落

summary.zh: 约公元前7000年，安纳托利亚西南部（今土耳其布尔杜尔省）的哈奇拉尔（Hacılar）遗址形成新石器时代聚落。居民从事农业和畜牧业，使用彩陶和石制工具。哈奇拉尔以其早期彩陶闻名，陶器上绘有几何纹和动物纹样。该遗址后在前5700年左右达到繁荣期，是安纳托利亚新石器时代文化的重要代表。

title.zh: 莱彭斯基维尔聚落形成

summary.zh: 多瑙河畔出现以鱼形雕塑闻名的狩猎采集者定居点，为欧洲早期艺术聚落代表。

statement.zh:
多瑙河畔出现以鱼形雕塑闻名的狩猎采集者定居点，为欧洲早期艺术聚落代表。聚落沿河阶地布置，房屋与墓葬形成相对固定的布局，鱼形与人面造型的石雕显示对自然和自身的观察。它说明狩猎采集者也能建立长期定居点，并在其中发展出稳定的仪式与艺术传统。

把「莱彭斯基维尔聚落形成」放回公元前6800年的塞尔维亚，可以看到考古变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Hunter-gatherer settlements famous for their fish-shaped sculptures appeared on the Danube River, representing early European art settlements.

title.zh: 日本绳文时代早期陶器繁荣

title.zh: 欧洲第一批农业村落出现

summary.zh: 约公元前6500年，第一批农业人群从安纳托利亚通过巴尔干半岛进入欧洲，在希腊、保加利亚和北马其顿等东南欧地区建立了最早的农业村落。居民种植小麦、大麦、豆类，饲养绵羊、山羊和牛，使用彩陶和磨制石器。这一过程被称为新石器时代农业扩张，在约3000年的时间里逐步传播到整个欧洲。

title.zh: 多格兰陆桥被北海淹没

summary.zh: 约公元前6200年，由于末次冰期结束后海平面持续上升，连接不列颠群岛与欧洲大陆的多格兰（Doggerland）陆桥最终被北海淹没。该地区曾是中石器时代狩猎采集者的重要栖息地，考古发现包括工具、骨器以及人类和动物足迹。海侵事件迫使数千居民向高地迁徙，留下了关于大洪水的口述记忆，可能启发了后世的大洪水传说。

statement.en: Around 6200 BCE, due to rising sea levels after the last ice age, the Doggerland land bridge connecting the British Isles to continental Europe was finally submerged by the North Sea.

title.zh: 水稻驯化在中国南方完成

summary.zh: 约公元前6000年，中国长江中下游的先民完成了水稻（Oryza sativa）的驯化。在浙江跨湖桥和河姆渡遗址发现了大规模炭化稻谷，表明当时稻作农业已相当成熟。水稻驯化是世界上最重要的植物驯化事件之一，养活了超过一半的世界人口。水稻种植随后向东南亚、南亚和东亚广泛传播。

statement.zh: 约公元前6000年，中国长江中下游的先民完成了水稻（Oryza sativa）的驯化。
statement.en: Around 6000 BCE, the ancestors of the Yangtze River basin in China completed the domestication of rice (Oryza sativa).

zh: 约公元前6000年，中国长江中下游的先民完成了水稻（Oryza sativa）的驯化。
en: Around 6000 BCE, the ancestors of the Yangtze River basin in China completed the domestication of rice (Oryza sativa).

summary.zh: 安纳托利亚与巴尔干先民开采并锤打自然铜制作饰物与小工具，开启人类金属利用的先声。

statement.zh:
安纳托利亚与巴尔干先民开采并锤打自然铜制作饰物与小工具，开启人类金属利用的先声。自然铜无需冶炼即可直接加工，先民以冷锻与退火改变其形状与硬度，制成珠子、别针与小型器具。对铜的加工经验为后来的熔炼与合金技术积累了知识。

把「冶金术起源（自然铜）」放回公元前6000年的安纳托利亚，可以看到工艺变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: The ancestors of Anatolia and the Balkans mined and hammered natural copper to make ornaments and small tools, pioneering the use of metals by mankind.

title.zh: 撒哈拉湿润期与非洲牧业起源

summary.zh: 约公元前5600年，非洲湿润期（African Humid Period）达到高峰。撒哈拉地区形成广阔的草原、湖泊和河流系统，尼日尔河内陆三角洲面积扩大。北非居民发展出牛牧业，在撒哈拉岩画（如塔西里-阿杰尔）中留下了大量牛群放牧和仪式场景。约前3500年后撒哈拉逐渐干旱化，人口向尼罗河谷迁移，促进了埃及文明的兴起。

title.zh: 苏美尔欧贝德文化开始

summary.zh: 约公元前5500年，两河流域南部的欧贝德文化开始形成，苏美尔人建立了最早的定居村落，发展出灌溉农业（种植大麦、小麦、椰枣），并开始建造小型神庙。欧贝德文化是苏美尔文明的前身，为后来乌鲁克时期城邦文明的兴起奠定了物质和文化基础。欧贝德时期的彩陶和神庙建筑对周边地区产生了广泛影响。

statement.zh: 巴尔干与近东出现高温熔炼铜矿石的冶炼技术，进入铜石并用时代，工具日趋坚固。冶炼把矿石、燃料与炉温控制结合起来，铜器可以重铸与加工，逐渐替代部分石制工具；铜石并用时代的技术积累又为后来的青铜合金奠定基础。这一转变说明材料创新如何改变生产与日常生活。

title.zh: 线纹陶文化传播农业至中欧

summary.zh: 约公元前5400-4900年，线纹陶文化（Linear Pottery Culture / LBK）从多瑙河流域沿着欧洲主要河流（多瑙河、莱茵河、维斯瓦河）迅速扩张，将农业经济从中欧传播至西欧。LBK农民种植小麦、大麦和豆类，饲养牛、羊和猪，建造长方形木制长屋（最长可达40米）。这是欧洲历史上最大规模的人口迁徙和文化传播事件之一，奠定了现代欧洲人口和语言分布

statement.zh: 约公元前5400-4900年，线纹陶文化（Linear Pottery Culture / LBK）从多瑙河流域沿着欧洲主要河流（多瑙河、莱茵河、维斯瓦河）迅速扩张，将农业经济从中欧传播至西欧。
statement.en: Around 5400-4900 BCE, the Linear Pottery Culture (LBK) expanded rapidly from the Danube basin along major European rivers (Danube, Rhine, Vistula), spreading the agricultural economy from central to western Europe.

en: Around 5400-4900 BCE, the Linear Pottery Culture (LBK) expanded rapidly from the Danube basin along major European rivers (Danube, Rhine, Vistula), spreading the agricultural economy from central to western Europe.

title.zh: 中国仰韶文化半坡类型开始

summary.zh: 约公元前5000年，黄河中游的仰韶文化半坡类型（今陕西西安半坡村）开始繁荣。居民建造了大型环壕聚落，内分居住区、制陶区和墓葬区，房屋为半地穴式方形或圆形建筑，外围挖有防御用的壕沟。半坡先民已种植粟（小米），饲养猪和狗，并使用彩陶（人面鱼纹盆为典型器物）。

statement.zh: 约公元前5000年，黄河中游的仰韶文化半坡类型（今陕西西安半坡村）开始繁荣。居民建造了大型环壕聚落，内分居住区、制陶区和墓葬区，房屋为半地穴式方形或圆形建筑，外围挖有防御用的壕沟。半坡先民已种植粟（小米），饲养猪和狗，并使用彩陶（人面鱼纹盆为典型器物）。
statement.en:
Around 5000 BCE, the Banpo phase of the Yangshao culture (modern Banpo village, Xi'an, Shaanxi) began to flourish in the middle Yellow River valley. Residents built a large settlement encircled by a ditch, divided into residential, pottery-making, and burial areas. Houses were semi-subterranean square or round structures, with defensive ditches dug around the perimeter. The Banpo people grew millet, raised pigs and dogs, and used painted pottery (the human-face fish basin is a typical artifact).

For Asia in 5000 BCE, “Beginning of Yangshao culture Banpo phase in China” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 埃及法尤姆文化发展农业

summary.zh: 约公元前5000-4700年，尼罗河流域法尤姆地区的居民开始了有组织的农业生产，种植小麦和大麦，饲养绵羊、山羊和猪。法尤姆文化使用石镰、石磨盘等工具，制作了编织篮筐和陶器。这是古埃及文明最早的农业先驱，为后来统一的法老文明提供了经济基础。

summary.zh: 约公元前5000年，巴尔干地区的温查文化在贝尔沃德（Belovode，今塞尔维亚）和普罗奇尼克（Pločnik）遗址进行了世界上已知最早的铜矿冶炼。考古发现包括铜斧、铜针和冶炼炉残渣，碳十四测年确认年代为约前5000年。这一发现将人类冶金史提前了约500年，表明欧洲在铜石并用时代的技术创新早于近东。

summary.zh: 约公元前5000年，中美洲（今墨西哥巴尔萨斯河谷）的古代居民开始驯化野生蜀黍（teosinte），经过数百年选育最终形成玉米（maize）。玉米成为中美洲文明的基础粮食作物，支撑了奥尔梅克、玛雅、阿兹特克等文明的兴起。玉米种植随后向北传播至北美，向南传播至南美安第斯地区。玉米驯化是新大陆农业革命最重要的事件之一。

statement.en:
The Yangshao culture (c. 5000–3000 BCE) rises in the middle Yellow River region where Henan, Shaanxi and Shanxi meet. Known for hand-made red painted pottery (fish and geometric designs) and semi-subterranean villages, it grows millet and raises pigs and dogs, and stands as the representative of China’s Neolithic painted-pottery tradition.

For Asia in 4900 BCE, “Yangshao culture emerges” is a traceable node of Society change whose significance is best read through later events.

summary.zh: 东欧草原边缘的库库泰尼-特里波利耶文化建起可容万人的环屋巨墟，定期焚毁重生。

statement.zh: 东欧草原边缘的库库泰尼-特里波利耶文化建起可容万人的环屋巨墟，定期焚毁重生。巨墟以环状房屋围绕中心空地，规模显示史前东欧的聚居与组织能力；定期焚毁可能与仪式、卫生或重建周期有关，具体原因仍有争论。这类聚落说明农业社会的集体居住可以达到很高的规模，也为研究史前城市规划提供材料。
statement.en: The Cucuteni-Tripoliye culture on the edge of the Eastern European steppes built huge ruins of ring houses that could accommodate ten thousand people, and they were burned down and reborn on a regular basis.

summary.zh: 约公元前4000年，美索不达米亚和欧洲的农民发明了犁（ard/scratch plow），由牛牵引翻耕土地。犁耕比锄耕效率提高数倍，使大面积耕作成为可能，释放了劳动力用于手工业和城市建设。犁的发明是农业革命的第二次重大突破，直接促进了社会分工、人口增长和早期文明的兴起。

title.zh: 中国仰韶文化庙底沟类型彩陶兴盛

summary.zh: 约公元前4000-3500年，仰韶文化庙底沟类型（河南陕县）发展出以花瓣纹、鸟纹为特色的彩陶工艺，其影响范围西至甘青、东到豫东、北达长城地带。庙底沟先民在聚落中心建造大型公共建筑，可能用于氏族议事和祭祀活动。

statement.zh: 约公元前4000-3500年，仰韶文化庙底沟类型（河南陕县）发展出以花瓣纹、鸟纹为特色的彩陶工艺，其影响范围西至甘青、东到豫东、北达长城地带。庙底沟先民在聚落中心建造大型公共建筑，可能用于氏族议事和祭祀活动。
statement.en:
Around 4000-3500 BCE, the Miaodigou type of the Yangshao culture (Shan County, Henan) developed painted pottery characterized by petal and bird motifs. Its influence extended west to Gansu and Qinghai, east to eastern Henan, and north to the Great Wall region. The Miaodigou people built large public buildings in the center of settlements, possibly used for clan councils and ritual activities.

For Asia in 4000 BCE, “Flourishing of painted pottery at Yangshao Miaodigou type” is a traceable node of Art change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 安第斯地区驯化马铃薯和藜麦

summary.zh: 约公元前4000年，安第斯山脉（今秘鲁和玻利维亚）的古代居民驯化了马铃薯（Solanum tuberosum）和藜麦（Chenopodium quinoa）。马铃薯是高海拔地区理想的粮食作物，产量高于谷物。马铃薯后来传入欧洲后引发了人口爆炸。藜麦富含蛋白质，是印加人的主要食物之一。这些作物的驯化代表了新大陆农业对世界文明的重要贡献。

title.zh: 中国马家窑文化出现铜刀

summary.zh: 约公元前3800年，甘肃东乡林家遗址的马家窑文化层出土了中国最早的青铜刀（含锡青铜），以单范铸造。这表明西北地区率先进入青铜时代早期，并与中亚草原文化交流。

statement.zh: 约公元前3800年，甘肃东乡林家遗址的马家窑文化层出土了中国最早的青铜刀，材质为含锡青铜，采用单范铸造。这件器物的意义不只在于年代早，更在于它把西北地区与早期青铜技术联系在一起：器形与铸造方式说明当地已经掌握合金与范铸的基本流程，而含锡青铜的出现又指向与中亚草原之间的技术与物料交流。
statement.en: Around 3800 BCE, the earliest bronze knife in China was unearthed from the Majiayao Cultural Layer of the Linjia Site in Dongxiang, Gansu Province.

statement.zh: 约前3800年，安徽含山凌家滩遗址出土玉人、玉龟与刻纹玉版，工艺精绝。玉人、玉龟与刻纹玉版并非孤立的小件，而是共同构成一套与礼仪和身份表达相关的器物组合；其精细的切割、钻孔与抛光说明当时已经存在专门化的玉器作坊，而大型聚落与高等级墓葬的存在又指向社会分层。把这批器物放回长江下游史前文化的序列中，它们代表良渚之前玉礼器传统的一个重要高峰。
statement.en: Around 3800 BCE the Lingjiatan site in Hanshan, Anhui, yields jade figures, a jade turtle and an incised jade plaque of exquisite workmanship.

title.zh: 埃及涅伽达文化II期（格尔津时期）开始

summary.zh: 约公元前3800年，涅伽达文化进入格尔津期（Naqada II / Gerzean），社会复杂化加速。贵族墓中出现更多进口物品（如来自黎凡特的沥青、来自阿富汗的青金石）。陶器上出现带有宗教象征的绘画，如双角妇女和船只图案，可能与王权观念形成有关。

title.zh: 苏美尔引进驴作为驮兽

summary.zh: 约公元前3800年，从叙利亚-安纳托利亚地区引进的驴被苏美尔人用于长途贸易运输。驴耐力强、饲料要求低，使得美索不达米亚与黎凡特、伊朗高原的商路更加通畅，奢侈品（如青金石、木材）流入增多。

title.zh: 中国红山文化牛河梁遗址建造祭祀坛庙

summary.zh: 约公元前3800-3000年，辽宁西部的红山文化在牛河梁（今建平县与凌源市交界处）建造了由女神庙、积石冢和祭坛组成的复杂祭祀中心。出土了大型泥塑女神像和玉猪龙，表明社会已出现神权贵族和早期等级制度。红山文化被认为是中国礼制的源头之一。

statement.zh: 约公元前3800-3000年，辽宁西部的红山文化在牛河梁（今建平县与凌源市交界处）建造了由女神庙、积石冢和祭坛组成的复杂祭祀中心。
statement.en: Around 3800-3000 BCE, the Hongshan culture in western Liaoning built a complex ritual center at Niuheliang (on the border of modern Jianping and Lingyuan counties), consisting of a goddess temple, stone burial mounds, and an altar.

title.zh: 叙利亚泰勒布拉克成为早期城邦

summary.zh: 约公元前3800年，美索不达米亚北部的泰勒布拉克（Tell Brak，今叙利亚东北部）发展为世界上最早的城市之一，面积约110公顷，人口约1.3万。遗址发现了大型行政建筑（眼睛神庙）和数千个滚印，证明其是重要的行政和贸易中心。泰勒布拉克与乌鲁克同时期繁荣，挑战了"城市革命仅发生在苏美尔"的传统观点，表明两河流域北部同样经历了早期的城市化进程。

statement.en: Around 3800 BCE, Tell Brak (northeastern Syria) in northern Mesopotamia developed into one of the world's earliest cities, covering about 110 hectares with a population of about 13,000.

title.zh: 泰勒哈穆卡尔城防工事与早期战争证据

summary.zh: 约公元前3600年，北美索不达米亚的泰勒哈穆卡尔（Tell Hamoukar，今叙利亚东北部）发现大规模城防工事和战争破坏层。考古发掘出大量泥球弹丸（约1200枚）和城墙崩塌遗迹，表明该城市曾遭到系统性攻击和劫掠。这是两河流域最早的攻城战证据之一，证明城市间冲突和军事冲突在文明早期就已出现。

title.zh: 埃及希拉孔波利斯成为上埃及宗教中心

summary.zh: 约公元前3600年，上埃及的希拉孔波利斯（Hierakonpolis，今考姆艾哈迈尔）开始建造祭祀荷鲁斯神的神庙，并出现带有精美雕刻的调色板。该城在后来的统一进程中成为那尔迈的基地，出土的著名的那尔迈调色板即发现于此。

title.zh: 野马在欧亚草原被驯化

statement.zh: 美索不达米亚与北高加索先后发明轮与车，极大提升运输与战争能力，并用于制陶转盘。轮的关键不只是圆形，而是轮轴与车架的配合，需要木工、绳索与畜力的整体技术；运输效率提高后，长距离的物资调动与贸易成为可能。同样的旋转原理又被用于陶轮，使器形更匀称、生产更快速，可见一项技术常在不同领域同时发挥作用。
statement.en: The wheel and cart are invented in Mesopotamia and the North Caucasus, transforming transport, warfare and the potter's craft.

title.zh: 埃兰文明与苏萨城兴起

summary.zh: 约公元前3500年，伊朗西南部的埃兰人在苏萨（Susa）建立最早的城市定居点。苏萨成为埃兰文明的政治和宗教中心，发展出独特的文字系统（原始埃兰文字）和艺术风格。埃兰与苏美尔之间进行了长达千年的贸易、文化交流和军事对抗。埃兰文明是伊朗高原最早的文明之一，对后来波斯帝国产生了深远影响。

title.zh: 苏美尔人发明原始楔形文字

summary.zh: 约公元前3400-3200年（乌鲁克第四层），乌鲁克的祭司和行政人员使用削尖的芦苇杆在湿润的黏土板上刻划符号，记录粮食、牲畜和劳动力的分配。这些原始楔形文字最初是象形符号，逐步演变为抽象楔形符号。目前最早的泥板发现于乌鲁克第四层，约含2000个独立符号。这是人类最早的成熟文字系统之一。

statement.zh: 约公元前3400-3200年（乌鲁克第四层），乌鲁克的祭司和行政人员使用削尖的芦苇杆在湿润的黏土板上刻划符号，记录粮食、牲畜和劳动力的分配。
statement.en: Around 3400-3200 BCE (Uruk IV layer), priests and administrators at Uruk used sharpened reeds to incise signs on moist clay tablets to record the distribution of grain, livestock, and labor.

sources.excerpt: In 1938 Adam Falkenstein listed 939 signs used in the earliest period, late Uruk, 34th to 31st centuries.

summary.zh: 约公元前3300年，古代近东进入青铜时代，锡青铜（铜锡合金）取代红铜成为制造工具和武器的主要材料。锡青铜硬度远高于纯铜，使更高效的工具和更锋利的武器成为可能。青铜冶金技术从美索不达米亚向外传播至安纳托利亚、伊朗、埃及和爱琴海地区。青铜时代的到来是古代世界继农业革命之后最重要的技术进步之一，深刻改变了战争、贸易和权力格局。

title.zh: 埃及蝎王二世（那尔迈前身）统治上埃及

summary.zh: 约公元前3200年，上埃及希拉孔波利斯的蝎王二世（Scorpion II）统治上埃及，并开始了统一尼罗河谷的战争。蝎王权标头刻画他手持锄头主持开渠灌溉的仪式，器物上残存的隼与弓形标记被认为象征其征服下埃及诸部。蝎王二世属前王朝末期（涅伽达三期）最后一批重要统治者，为那尔迈最终统一上下埃及奠定了基础。

statement.zh: 约公元前3200年，上埃及希拉孔波利斯的蝎王二世（Scorpion II）统治上埃及，并开始了统一尼罗河谷的战争。
statement.en: Around 3200 BCE, Scorpion II of Hierakonpolis ruled Upper Egypt and began the wars that would unify the Nile Valley.

sources.locator: Article on Menes, paragraphs on the unification of Egypt
sources.excerpt: Menes (flourished c. 2900 BCE) was the legendary first king of unified Egypt, who, according to tradition, joined Upper and Lower Egypt in a single centralized monarchy and established ancient Egypt’s 1st dynasty. Modern scholars have inconclusively identified the legendary Menes with one or more of the archaic Egyptian kings bearing the names Scorpion, Narmer, and Aha. Actually, the whole process probably required several reigns, and the traditional Menes may well represent the kings involved.

summary.zh: 前第四千纪末，埃及出现刻在陶罐与象牙牌上的象形文字；它从一开始就使用表音符号，既写宗教文本，也写法律和科学文书。会读写的只有官员、祭司和工匠，日常书写用僧侣体。文字首先是税收、劳役和王权的记账工具。

statement.zh: 埃及最早的象形文字出现在公元前第四千纪末，刻在陶罐和象牙牌上，通常用于标识死者。
statement.en: The earliest Egyptian hieroglyphs date to the end of the fourth millennium BCE and were incised on pottery jars and ivory plaques, usually to identify the dead.

sources.locator: Britannica, Hieroglyphic writing, 'Development of Egyptian hieroglyphic writing'
sources.excerpt: The most ancient hieroglyphs date from the end of the 4th millennium bce and comprise annotations incised onto pottery jars and ivory plaques deposited in tombs, presumably for the purpose of identification of the dead.

zh:
公元前第四千纪末，埃及的墓葬里出现刻在陶罐和象牙牌上的符号。埃及最早的象形文字出现在公元前第四千纪末，刻在陶罐和象牙牌上，通常用于标识死者。它们还不是长篇文章，而是名字、头衔、物品和归属的标记。

这些早期符号从一开始就具有表音功能，埃及没有经历过一个“纯图画”阶段。一个画出来的物件，往往不是它本身，而是读音相近的另一个词。

到后来，象形文字既用于宗教文本，也用于历史铭文、歌曲、法律和科学文书。神庙墙上的颂歌与官员账本上的数字，用的是同一套符号体系。

但会读会写的人始终很少。只有官员、祭司和工匠等少数人掌握象形文字；日常书写使用更简化的僧侣体。书写因此是一种官职技能，不是全民教育。

文字首先不是文学，而是税收、劳役和王权的记账工具；谁掌握书写，谁就能把名字、收成和人手变成可执行的记录。
en:
At the end of the fourth millennium BCE, marks cut into pottery jars and ivory plaques began to appear in Egyptian tombs. The earliest Egyptian hieroglyphs date to the end of the fourth millennium BCE and were incised on pottery jars and ivory plaques, usually to identify the dead. They were not yet long texts but labels of names, titles, goods and ownership.

These early signs were phonetic from the start; Egypt did not pass through a purely pictorial stage. A drawn object often stood not for itself but for another word that sounded similar.

Hieroglyphs were used for religious texts as well as historical inscriptions, songs, legal and scientific documents. The hymns on temple walls and the figures in an official's ledger used the same sign system.

Yet those who could read and write remained few. Only a limited circle of officials, priests and craftsmen understood hieroglyphs; everyday writing used the simplified hieratic script. Writing was an office skill, not universal schooling.

Writing was first of all a tool of taxation, labour and royal power, not literature; whoever controlled writing could turn names, harvests and manpower into actionable records.

note.zh: 年代、载体与用途照条目；不写“前3200年已有成熟文本”。
note.en: Date, medium and purpose follow the entry; no claim that mature texts existed by 3200 BCE.

statement.zh: 这些早期符号从一开始就具有表音功能，埃及没有经历过一个“纯图画”阶段。
statement.en: These early signs were phonetic from the start; Egypt did not pass through a purely pictorial stage.

sources.locator: Britannica, Hieroglyphic writing, 'Development of Egyptian hieroglyphic writing'
sources.excerpt: This circumstance means that hieroglyphs were from the very beginning phonetic symbols. An earlier stage consisting exclusively of picture writing using actual illustrations of the intended words cannot be shown to have existed in Egypt; indeed, such a stage can with great probability be ruled out.

公元前第四千纪末，埃及的墓葬里出现刻在陶罐和象牙牌上的符号。埃及最早的象形文字出现在公元前第四千纪末，刻在陶罐和象牙牌上，通常用于标识死者。它们还不是长篇文章，而是名字、头衔、物品和归属的标记。

这些早期符号从一开始就具有表音功能，埃及没有经历过一个“纯图画”阶段。一个画出来的物件，往往不是它本身，而是读音相近的另一个词。

到后来，象形文字既用于宗教文本，也用于历史铭文、歌曲、法律和科学文书。神庙墙上的颂歌与官员账本上的数字，用的是同一套符号体系。

但会读会写的人始终很少。只有官员、祭司和工匠等少数人掌握象形文字；日常书写使用更简化的僧侣体。书写因此是一种官职技能，不是全民教育。

文字首先不是文学，而是税收、劳役和王权的记账工具；谁掌握书写，谁就能把名字、收成和人手变成可执行的记录。
en:
At the end of the fourth millennium BCE, marks cut into pottery jars and ivory plaques began to appear in Egyptian tombs. The earliest Egyptian hieroglyphs date to the end of the fourth millennium BCE and were incised on pottery jars and ivory plaques, usually to identify the dead. They were not yet long texts but labels of names, titles, goods and ownership.

These early signs were phonetic from the start; Egypt did not pass through a purely pictorial stage. A drawn object often stood not for itself but for another word that sounded similar.

Hieroglyphs were used for religious texts as well as historical inscriptions, songs, legal and scientific documents. The hymns on temple walls and the figures in an official's ledger used the same sign system.

Yet those who could read and write remained few. Only a limited circle of officials, priests and craftsmen understood hieroglyphs; everyday writing used the simplified hieratic script. Writing was an office skill, not universal schooling.

Writing was first of all a tool of taxation, labour and royal power, not literature; whoever controlled writing could turn names, harvests and manpower into actionable records.

note.en: Author judgment: places writing back into administration and royal power.

title.zh: 孟斐斯白墙宫殿及普塔神庙兴建

summary.zh: 约公元前3100年，法老那尔迈在尼罗河西岸建造名为白墙（Ineb-hedj）的宫殿和防御工事，后来发展为孟斐斯城。同时为工匠神普塔建立神庙，普塔成为孟斐斯的地方主神。

statement.zh: 约公元前3100年，法老那尔迈在尼罗河西岸建造名为白墙（Ineb-hedj）的宫殿和防御工事，后来发展为孟斐斯城；同时为工匠神普塔建立神庙，普塔由此成为孟斐斯的地方主神。宫殿、防御工事与神庙在同一地点出现，说明新建的政治中心从一开始就同时具备行政、军事与宗教功能；而“白墙”这一名称也提示城墙在城市起源中的象征意义。
statement.en: Around 3100 BCE, Pharaoh Narmer built a palace and fortification called White Wall (Ineb-hedj) on the west bank of the Nile, which later developed into Memphis.

title.zh: 那尔迈确立荷鲁斯王衔

summary.zh: 约公元前3100年，那尔迈将自己的名字写在塞拉赫（serekh）代表王宫门面的长方形框中，上方站立荷鲁斯鹰神。这种荷鲁斯名成为此后所有法老王衔的核心部分，宣称法老是荷鲁斯在人间的化身。

statement.zh: 约公元前3100年，那尔迈将自己的名字写进塞拉赫（serekh）——一个代表王宫门面的长方形框——上方站立荷鲁斯鹰神。把王名与神鹰组合在同一符号中，等于把王权直接置于荷鲁斯的庇护之下；这种荷鲁斯名后来成为所有法老王衔的核心部分，宣称法老是荷鲁斯在人间的化身。
statement.en: Around 3100 BCE, Narmer inscribed his name into the serekh - a rectangular frame representing the palace's facade - above which stands the falcon god Horus.

title.zh: 那尔迈调色板：统一被画成一个王

summary.zh: 传统把美尼斯当作统一上下埃及的第一位国王；现代学者把他与那尔迈、阿哈等早期国王作不完全对应。那尔迈调色板约前2900年出土于希拉孔波利斯，用白冠与红冠把两个王国合在一个王名下。统一更可能延续数代。

statement.zh: 传统把美尼斯当作统一上下埃及的第一位国王，并把他与第一王朝的建立联系在一起。
statement.en: Tradition makes Menes the first king to unify Upper and Lower Egypt and credits him with founding the 1st dynasty.

sources.excerpt: Menes (flourished c. 2900 bce) was the legendary first king of unified Egypt, who, according to tradition, joined Upper and Lower Egypt in a single centralized monarchy and established ancient Egypt’s 1st dynasty.

zh: 传统把美尼斯当作统一上下埃及的第一位国王，并把他与第一王朝的建立联系在一起。
en: Tradition makes Menes the first king to unify Upper and Lower Egypt and credits him with founding the 1st dynasty.

note.zh: 写“传统”而非“确证”；不写美尼斯留下同时代档案。
note.en: Says 'tradition', not proven fact; no contemporary archive left by Menes.

statement.en: Modern scholars have not conclusively identified Menes with Narmer, Aha or other early kings.

sources.excerpt: Modern scholars have inconclusively identified the legendary Menes with one or more of the archaic Egyptian kings bearing the names Scorpion, Narmer, and Aha.

statement.en: The Narmer Palette was found at Hierakonpolis, dates to the beginning of the 1st dynasty, c. 2900 BCE, and shows Narmer wearing the White Crown.

statement.zh: 调色板另一面通常被读作红冠；两顶王冠把上下埃及合在一个王名下，但这是纪念性表达，不是行政记录。
statement.en: The other side is usually read as the Red Crown; the two crowns place Upper and Lower Egypt under one royal name, but this is commemorative imagery, not an administrative record.

statement.zh: 统一更可能延续数代：真正的整合发生在税册、边界、都城与地方官身上，而不是一场战役之后。
statement.en: Unification more likely took several generations: the real integration lay in tax rolls, borders, a capital and local officials, not in the aftermath of one battle.

title.zh: 苏美尔人建立城邦防御体系

summary.zh: 约公元前3100年，为争夺水源和农田，苏美尔各城邦（乌鲁克、乌尔、拉格什等）开始用土坯砖建造环绕全城的城墙。城防的出现标志着战争从部落冲突升级为城邦之间的正规战争，促进了军事技术和职业士兵的发展。

statement.zh: 约公元前3100年，为争夺水源和农田，苏美尔各城邦（乌鲁克、乌尔、拉格什等）开始用土坯砖建造环绕全城的城墙。城防的出现标志着战争从部落冲突升级为城邦之间的正规战争，促进了军事技术和职业士兵的发展。
statement.en:
Around 3100 BCE, vying for water and farmland, Sumerian city-states (Uruk, Ur, Lagash, etc.) began to encircle their settlements with walls made of mudbrick. The appearance of city defenses marked the escalation of warfare from tribal conflict to formal war between city-states, promoting the development of military technology and professional soldiers.

For Asia in 3100 BCE, “Sumerians build city-state defensive systems” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

summary.zh: 上埃及国王那尔迈击败下埃及，实现上下埃及统一，定都孟菲斯，开启埃及早王朝时期。

statement.zh: 上埃及国王那尔迈击败下埃及，实现上下埃及统一，定都孟菲斯，开启埃及早王朝时期。统一的标志是王衔与双冠的出现，行政上则以孟菲斯为界整合南北的税收与祭祀体系；王室铭刻把胜利叙述为秩序对混乱的征服，成为后世法老图像的范式。南北合并奠定了此后长期沿用的国家结构，也确立了王权与神庙互为支撑的格局。
statement.en: King Narmer of Upper Egypt defeats Lower Egypt, unifying the two lands and founding the Early Dynastic Period with a capital at Memphis.

title.zh: 苏美尔乌鲁克文化晚期鼎盛

summary.zh: 约公元前3100年，乌鲁克城面积达到约250公顷，人口估计四万至五万，成为当时世界上最大的城市。城墙总长约9公里，内部有安努神庙区、埃安娜神庙区和大型仓库区。乌鲁克文化通过贸易和殖民将楔形文字、滚印和计量制度传播到叙利亚和伊朗西部。吉尔伽美什史诗中的乌鲁克城墙即修建于此时期。

zh:
约公元前3100年，乌鲁克文化进入晚期。乌鲁克是两河流域南部最大的聚落，纪念性土坯建筑以彩色泥锥镶嵌装饰。大型圆雕、浮雕和失蜡法金属铸造也在这一时期出现。

把「苏美尔乌鲁克文化晚期鼎盛」放回公元前3100年的美索不达米亚，它连接了文化在长时段中的前后变化。
en: By about 3100 BCE, late Uruk culture was at its height. Uruk covered roughly 250 hectares and may have held 40,000 to 50,000 people, making it the largest city of its time. A wall about 9 kilometres long enclosed the Anu and Eanna temple districts and large storage areas. Monumental mud-brick buildings were decorated with painted clay cones, while large-scale sculpture, relief carving and lost-wax metal casting appeared in the same period. Through trade and colonization, Uruk culture carried cuneiform writing, cylinder seals and systems of measurement into Syria and western Iran. The city's scale, dense population and ceremonial core made it a model for later Mesopotamian urban life, and the walls remembered in the Epic of Gilgamesh belong to this phase.

summary.zh: 早王朝时期埃及在尼罗河三角洲与河谷交界处建都孟菲斯，成为古王国近三千年政治宗教中心。

statement.zh: 约前3000年起，两河流域与伊朗高原普遍掌握锡青铜冶炼——以铜锡合金取代自然铜与砷铜，器物更坚硬耐磨，武器、工具与礼器随之普及，人类历史进入青铜时代，金属资源与远途贸易的重要性骤增。
statement.en:
From about 3000 BC Mesopotamia and the Iranian plateau mastered tin-bronze casting, alloying copper with tin to make a harder, more durable metal than native or arsenical copper. Weapons, tools and ritual objects spread widely, ushering in the Bronze Age and raising the stakes of long-distance metal trade.

For Asia in 3000 BCE, “Bronze Age metallurgy” is a traceable node of Craft change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 法老登首次使用双重王冠，标志上下埃及完全统一

summary.zh: 约公元前3000年，哲尔之子登（Den）继位后在阿比多斯石碑上首次同时佩戴红冠和白冠，正式宣布上下埃及完全统一。他在位时期加强了努比亚边境防御，设立下埃及大臣官职，并记录了第一次完整的塞德节（Heb-Sed，法老在位30年后举行的力量更新仪式）。登的墓中出土了第一块完整的王名表。

statement.zh: 南西伯利亚的阿凡纳谢沃文化（约前3300—前2500）已出现青铜与驯马，墓葬中见马车与羊骨，是草原地带最早的畜牧人群之一，或与原始印欧语族群相关。墓葬以土石封堆，随葬的金属器与家畜显示畜牧与冶金的结合；人群的迁徙与草原早期的文化交流由此可寻线索。
statement.en: Bronze and tame horses have appeared in the Avanaschevo culture of southern Siberia (approximately 3300 BCE - 2500 BCE), and carriages and sheep bones are found in tombs.

title.zh: 法老登指挥西奈半岛采矿远征

summary.zh: 约公元前3000年，登率领一万人的军队穿越西奈沙漠，控制了绿松石和铜矿场（今塞拉比特·卡迪姆）。他在当地建造了哈索尔女神神庙，并设立了法老铜像，标志着埃及对西奈资源的直接控制。

statement.zh: 约公元前3000年，登率领一万人的军队穿越西奈沙漠，控制了绿松石和铜矿场（今塞拉比特·卡迪姆）。他在当地建造哈索尔女神神庙，并设立法老铜像，使这次远征不只是资源攫取，也成为埃及在王权象征与宗教空间上对西奈的直接宣示；矿场、神庙与铜像三者并置，说明军事行动、资源开发与祭祀体系被同时推进。

title.zh: 基克拉迪文明在大希腊群岛繁荣

summary.zh: 奥克尼群岛立起直径约104米的巨型新石器石圈，为不列颠诸岛最大石环之一。

statement.zh: 奥克尼群岛立起直径约104米的巨型新石器石圈，为不列颠诸岛最大石环之一。石圈由直立巨石围成，周围有壕沟与路径，可能与祭祀、集会及天文观测有关；它与奥克尼群岛的其他新石器遗址共同构成一片仪式景观。石圈的尺度说明当地社群能够组织远距离搬运与长期营造。
statement.en: A giant Neolithic stone circle with a diameter of about 104 meters was erected in the Orkney Islands, which is one of the largest stone circles in the British Isles.

title.zh: 法老卡阿恢复秩序，结束第一王朝

summary.zh: 约公元前2900年，卡阿（Qaa）重新巩固了中央权力，修建了宏伟的墓室（阿比多斯编号Q），并结束了人祭传统，改用替代性的人偶。他是第一王朝的最后一位法老。第一王朝共持续约200年，历经8位法老。

statement.zh: 约公元前2900年，卡阿（Qaa）重新巩固了中央权力，修建了宏伟的墓室（阿比多斯编号Q），并结束了人祭传统，改用替代性的人偶。他是第一王朝的最后一位法老。第一王朝共持续约200年，历经8位法老。
statement.en:
Around 2900 BCE, Qa'a reconsolidated central power, built a magnificent tomb (Abydos tomb Q), and ended the practice of human sacrifice, replacing it with substitute figurines. He was the last pharaoh of the First Dynasty, which lasted about 200 years with 8 pharaohs.

For Africa in 2900 BCE, “Pharaoh Qa'a restores order, ends First Dynasty” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 中国龙山文化蛋壳黑陶技术出现

summary.zh: 约公元前2900-2300年，黄河下游的龙山文化前期，陶工发明了轮制拉坯和渗碳工艺，烧制出厚度仅1-2毫米的蛋壳黑陶，表面乌黑光亮。这类高柄杯主要用于贵族祭祀，反映了社会等级分化加深。

statement.zh: 约公元前2900-2300年，黄河下游的龙山文化前期，陶工发明了轮制拉坯和渗碳工艺，烧制出厚度仅1-2毫米的蛋壳黑陶，表面乌黑光亮。
statement.en: Around 2900-2300 BCE, potters of the early Longshan culture in the lower Yellow River valley invented wheel-throwing and carburizing processes, producing eggshell black pottery only 1-2 mm thick, with a glossy black surface.

title.zh: 印度河流域文明从村落走向城市

summary.zh: 印度河流域文明从使用灌溉农业的村落演化而来，核心年代约公元前2600—前1900年。哈拉帕与摩亨佐-达罗是两座最大城市，各约1.6公里见方；周边还有百余座城镇与村落。

statement.zh: 这一文明的核心年代约公元前2600—前1900年，南部遗址可能延续得更久。
statement.en: The nuclear dates of the civilisation are about 2600–1900 BCE, and southern sites may have lasted longer.

sources.excerpt: The nuclear dates of the civilization appear to be about 2600–1900 BCE, although the southern sites may have lasted later into the 2nd millennium BCE.

zh: 这一文明的核心年代约公元前2600—前1900年，南部遗址可能延续得更久。
en: The nuclear dates of the civilisation are about 2600–1900 BCE, and southern sites may have lasted longer.

statement.zh: 印度河流域文明从使用灌溉农业的村落演化而来；到大城市阶段，哈拉帕与摩亨佐-达罗成为两座中心，每座约1.6公里见方，周围还有百余座较小的城镇与村落。
statement.en: The civilisation evolved from villages using irrigated agriculture; Harappa and Mohenjo-daro were each perhaps about 1.6 km square, with more than 100 towns and villages around them.

sources.locator: Indus civilization，村落演化与城市规模段
sources.excerpt: The Indus civilization apparently evolved from the villages of neighbors or predecessors, using the Mesopotamian model of irrigated agriculture... The two cities were each perhaps originally about 1 mile (1.6 km) square in overall dimensions... and more than 100 towns and villages.

zh: 印度河流域文明不是突然出现的。它从使用灌溉农业的村落演化而来；到大城市阶段，哈拉帕与摩亨佐-达罗成为两座中心，每座约1.6公里见方，周围还有百余座较小的城镇与村落。
en: The Indus civilisation did not appear all at once. It evolved from villages that used irrigated agriculture; in the urban phase, Harappa and Mohenjo-daro became the two centres, each perhaps about 1.6 km square, with more than 100 smaller towns and villages around them.

statement.zh: 把“最早的城市”写成一天建成，会遮住村落、灌溉与贸易网络长期积累的过程。
statement.en: Writing the “first cities” as something built in a day hides the long accumulation of villages, irrigation and trade networks.

statement.zh:
苏美尔早王朝时期，乌鲁克与埃利都等城邦出现阶梯塔庙（Ziggurat）原型，成为苏美尔宗教建筑的标志。塔庙以土坯与砖层层砌筑，顶部设祭坛，既是祭祀场所，也是城邦权力的象征；其形制与祭仪影响了后来的两河建筑。

把「苏美尔塔庙雏形出现」放回公元前2900年的苏美尔，可以看到宗教变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: During the Early Dynasty of Sumer, prototypes of the Ziggurat temple appeared in city-states such as Uruk and Eridu, which became a symbol of Sumerian religious architecture.

title.zh: 第二王朝建立者霍特普塞海姆威继位

summary.zh: 约公元前2890年，卡阿死后权力斗争导致第一王朝终结，霍特普塞海姆威（Hotepsekhemwy）建立第二王朝。他的名字意为两种权力和平，暗示通过妥协统一了上埃及和下埃及的地方势力。

statement.zh: 约公元前2890年，卡阿死后权力斗争导致第一王朝终结，霍特普塞海姆威（Hotepsekhemwy）建立第二王朝。他的名字意为两种权力和平，暗示通过妥协统一了上埃及和下埃及的地方势力。
statement.en:
Around 2890 BCE, after Qa'a's death, power struggles ended the First Dynasty. Hotepsekhemwy founded the Second Dynasty. His name means 'the two powers are at peace', suggesting he unified the forces of Upper and Lower Egypt through compromise.

For Africa in 2900 BCE, “Hotepsekhemwy, founder of the Second Dynasty, succeeds” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 特洛伊II期出现双重城墙和宫殿

summary.zh: 约公元前2800-2600年，特洛伊遗址的第二层（Troy II）建造了长达300米的巨大石砌城墙和平面呈矩形的王宫，内有高屋顶的巨大厅。该层因财富和火灾痕迹曾被施里曼错误地认为是荷马的特洛伊。

statement.zh: 约公元前2800—2600年，特洛伊遗址的第二层（Troy II）建造了长达300米的巨大石砌城墙和平面呈矩形的王宫，内有高屋顶的巨大厅。城墙与王宫的规模说明该聚落已具备集中防御与统治中心；而这一层同时留下财富与火灾痕迹，后来被施里曼误认作荷马笔下的特洛伊。
statement.en: Around 2800-2600 BCE, a huge 300-meter-long stone city wall and a rectangular palace with a huge hall with a high roof were built on the second level of the Troy ruins (Troy II).

title.zh: 法老伯里布森改奉塞特神，反映宗教内战

summary.zh: 约公元前2800年，第二王朝法老伯里布森（Peribsen）放弃了传统的荷鲁斯名，改以塞特神（混乱与沙漠之神）作为自己的保护神，并以塞特动物代替塞拉赫上的鹰隼。这很可能反映了当时埃及内部的宗教分裂甚至内战，暗示了上埃及和下埃及之间的持续紧张。

statement.en: Around 2800 BCE, Second Dynasty Pharaoh Peribsen abandoned the traditional Horus name and adopted the god Seth (god of chaos and desert) as his patron, replacing the falcon on the serekh with the Seth animal.

title.zh: 中国良渚文化瑶山祭坛建筑

summary.zh: 约公元前2800年，良渚文化（约公元前3300-2300年）在浙江余杭瑶山遗址修筑了覆斗式祭坛和贵族墓地，祭坛兼有观测和祭祀功能，说明良渚社会已经形成统一的宗教信仰和权力体系。良渚文化以发达的稻作农业、大规模水利工程和精美的玉器闻名，是探索中华文明起源的关键文化之一。

statement.zh: 约公元前2800年，良渚文化（约公元前3300-2300年）在浙江余杭瑶山遗址修筑了覆斗式祭坛和贵族墓地，祭坛兼有观测和祭祀功能。这说明良渚社会已经形成统一的宗教信仰和权力体系。良渚文化以发达的稻作农业、大规模水利工程和精美的玉器闻名，是探索中华文明起源的关键文化之一。
statement.en:
Around 2800 BCE, the Liangzhu culture (c. 3300-2300 BCE) built a stepped altar and elite cemetery at Yaoshan in Yuhang, Zhejiang. The altar likely served both observational and ritual functions, indicating that Liangzhu society had formed a unified religious belief and power system. Liangzhu culture is known for its developed rice agriculture, large-scale water conservancy projects, and exquisite jade artifacts, and is a key culture in exploring the origins of Chinese civilization.

For Asia in 2800 BCE, “Construction of Yaoshan altar in Liangzhu culture, China” is a traceable node of Religion change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 卡拉尔金字塔平台开始建造

summary.zh: 约公元前2700年，小北文明的中心卡拉尔（Caral）开始在秘鲁干旱山谷中建造大型阶梯金字塔平台（最大的高约18米）。卡拉尔人以棉花和鱼类交换为基础，发展了和平的贸易社会，没有城防设施。卡拉尔是美洲最古老的城市遗址之一，年代可追溯至公元前3000年。

title.zh: 法老哈塞海姆威重新统一埃及，结束第二王朝

summary.zh: 约公元前2700年，哈塞海姆威（Khasekhemwy，意为双重权力显现）重新统一上下埃及，在希拉孔波利斯的雕像底座刻有48205名北方敌人被杀的铭文。他在阿比多斯建造了大型石质墓室（V号墓），并在墓内放置了大量铜制工具。他是第二王朝最后一位法老，也是第三王朝的直接先驱。

statement.en: Around 2700 BCE, Khasekhemwy (meaning 'the two powers appear') reunified Upper and Lower Egypt, with inscriptions on his statue base at Hierakonpolis recording the killing of 48,205 northern enemies.

title.zh: 左塞尔的阶梯金字塔：石构国家项目

summary.zh: 第三王朝首位国王左塞尔在萨卡拉建阶梯金字塔，建筑师兼医师伊姆霍特普主持。六层约61米，地下约400个房间，围墙约1.6公里。它不是“第一座金字塔”，而是最早的重要石构建筑和国家工程模板。

statement.zh: 左塞尔是第三王朝的第一位国王，在萨卡拉兴建埃及最早的重要石构建筑。
statement.en: Djoser was the first king of the 3rd dynasty and built Egypt's earliest important stone building at Saqqara.

sources.excerpt: Djoser, was the first king of the 3rd dynasty (c. 2592–c. 2566 bce) of ancient Egypt, who undertook the construction of the earliest important stone building in Egypt.

zh: 左塞尔是第三王朝的第一位国王，在萨卡拉兴建埃及最早的重要石构建筑。
en: Djoser was the first king of the 3rd dynasty and built Egypt's earliest important stone building at Saqqara.

note.zh: 写“最早的重要石构建筑”，不写“第一座金字塔”。
note.en: Says 'earliest important stone building', not 'first pyramid'.

statement.zh: 伊姆霍特普是左塞尔的建筑师兼医师，后世把他神化。
statement.en: Imhotep was Djoser's architect and physician, and later generations deified him.

sources.excerpt: His minister, Imhotep, a talented architect and physician, was himself deified in later periods.

zh: 伊姆霍特普是左塞尔的建筑师兼医师，后世把他神化。
en: Imhotep was Djoser's architect and physician, and later generations deified him.

note.zh: 只写 architect/physician 与 deified；不扩写神职。
note.en: Only architect/physician and deified; no invented divine offices.

statement.zh: 阶梯金字塔由六层石与泥砖构成，高约61米，原表面覆盖白色石灰石。
statement.en: The Step Pyramid consists of six tiers of stone and clay, rises about 61 metres, and was originally covered in white limestone.

sources.locator: Britannica, Step Pyramid of Djoser, description
sources.excerpt: Its diminishing six-tier “step” layers of stone and clay rose to a height of about 200 feet (61 m) and were originally covered in gleaming white limestone.

zh: 阶梯金字塔由六层石与泥砖构成，高约61米，原表面覆盖白色石灰石。
en: The Step Pyramid consists of six tiers of stone and clay, rises about 61 metres, and was originally covered in white limestone.

note.zh: 六层、约61米、白色石灰石照条目。
note.en: Six tiers, about 61 m and white limestone follow the entry.

statement.zh: 金字塔地下有廊道和约400个房间；外围墙长约1.6公里，原高约11米。
statement.en: Beneath the pyramid are galleries and some 400 rooms; the wall around the complex is about 1.6 kilometres long and was originally about 11 metres high.

sources.locator: Britannica, Step Pyramid of Djoser, description
sources.excerpt: Beneath the pyramid was an underground structure of unprecedented size and complexity, with galleries and some 400 rooms. … The wall around the complex was more than 1 mile (1.6 km) long and originally 34 feet (11 m) high.

zh: 金字塔地下有廊道和约400个房间；外围墙长约1.6公里，原高约11米。
en: Beneath the pyramid are galleries and some 400 rooms; the wall around the complex is about 1.6 kilometres long and was originally about 11 metres high.

note.zh: 地下房间与围墙数字照条目；不写“全部对外开放”。
note.en: Underground rooms and wall figures follow the entry; no claim that all are open.

statement.zh: 阶梯金字塔的意义不只是王陵：它把采石、运输、工匠、口粮和祭祀组织成一个可重复的工程模板。
statement.en: The Step Pyramid was more than a royal tomb: it turned quarrying, transport, craftsmen, rations and ritual into a repeatable engineering template.

note.en: Author judgment: links architectural form to engineering organisation.

title.zh: 克里特米诺斯文明早期阶段（前宫殿时期）

sources.excerpt: The ruins of the huge city of Moenjodaro – built entirely of unbaked brick in the 3rd millennium B.C. – lie in the Indus valley.

zh:
摩亨佐-达罗位于印度河河谷，公元前第三千纪以砖建成。卫城建在高台和壁垒之内，下城按严格规则布局；街道直角相交，排水、公共浴池、水井、污水渗坑与大谷仓一同出现。

摩亨佐-达罗遗址覆盖约240公顷，至今只发掘约三分之一。城市的“规划感”不是一张现代复原图，而是街道方向、砖的规格和排水沟走向在废墟里反复出现。
en:
Mohenjo-daro lies in the Indus valley and was built of brick in the third millennium BCE. The acropolis stood on high embankments within ramparts, while the lower town was laid out according to strict rules; streets crossed at right angles, and drainage, public baths, wells, soak pits and a large granary appeared together.

The ruins cover about 240 ha, of which only about one third has been excavated. The city's “planned” quality is not a modern reconstruction drawing but the repeated alignment of streets, brick dimensions and drainage channels in the ruins themselves.

title.zh: 哈拉帕与摩亨佐-达罗：没有王宫的城市秩序

summary.zh: 两座大城市都出现网格街道与排水系统；统一的度量衡和大谷仓说明存在较强的行政协调，但王权与政府形式仍无法从现有材料确定。

statement.zh: 哈拉帕与摩亨佐-达罗都出现网格街道与排水系统。
statement.en: Harappa and Mohenjo-daro both had grid streets and drainage systems.

sources.locator: Brief synthesis，街道直角相交与排水系统句
sources.excerpt: Here buildings are laid out along streets intersecting each other at right angles, in a highly orderly form of city planning that also incorporated systems of sanitation and drainage.

zh: 哈拉帕与摩亨佐-达罗都出现网格街道与排水系统。
en: Harappa and Mohenjo-daro both had grid streets and drainage systems.

statement.zh: 统一的度量衡、大谷仓和跨聚落的建筑尺度，说明城市之间共享一套规范；这套规范需要某种行政协调来维持。
statement.en: Uniform weights and measures, great granaries and shared building scales suggest that the cities shared one set of norms; maintaining that set required some form of administrative coordination.

sources.excerpt: The remarkable uniformity of weights and measures throughout the Indus lands, as well as the development of such presumably civic works as the great granaries, implies a strong degree of political and administrative control over a wide area.

zh: 统一的度量衡、大谷仓和跨聚落的建筑尺度，说明城市之间共享一套规范；这套规范需要某种行政协调来维持。
en: Uniform weights and measures, great granaries and shared building scales suggest that the cities shared one set of norms; maintaining that set required some form of administrative coordination.

statement.zh: 但“谁在发号施令”仍不清楚。遗址里没有可读的王室铭文，也没有一座能被确认为王宫的建筑；把印度河城市直接写成某个国王的都城，是拿美索不达米亚的模板套过来。
statement.en: But who gave the orders remains unclear. The ruins have no readable royal inscriptions and no building that can be identified as a palace; describing an Indus city directly as the capital of a king borrows a Mesopotamian template.

zh: 但“谁在发号施令”仍不清楚。遗址里没有可读的王室铭文，也没有一座能被确认为王宫的建筑；把印度河城市直接写成某个国王的都城，是拿美索不达米亚的模板套过来。
en: But who gave the orders remains unclear. The ruins have no readable royal inscriptions and no building that can be identified as a palace; describing an Indus city directly as the capital of a king borrows a Mesopotamian template.

statement.zh: 秘鲁苏佩河谷的卡拉尔为美洲最古老城市之一，以大型土坯平台与圆形剧场著称。城市以土坯与石料建造，平台、广场与住宅区组成有规划的布局；其存在说明安第斯地区在城市与国家形成之前已出现大规模的聚居与公共工程。卡拉尔也为理解美洲早期文明的组织能力提供了关键证据。

title.zh: 胡夫大金字塔开始建造

summary.zh: 约公元前2580年，胡夫征调全国劳力（估计常年2-3万人）在吉萨高地开凿基岩，堆砌巨大的石灰石块。金字塔最初高度约146.6米，底边长230.4米，倾斜角度51度50分。工匠使用木质滚轮、斜坡和杠杆运输石块。整个工程耗时约20-30年，使用了约230万块巨石，总重量约590万吨。

title.zh: 吉萨大金字塔：把全国物流压进一座山

summary.zh: 第四王朝的胡夫、哈夫拉、门卡乌拉在吉萨建三座金字塔。胡夫大金字塔底边约230米、原高147米、约230万块石头、575万吨。希罗多德说20年/10万人，现代研究提出可能约2万人加支持人员；工人区有面包房、作坊和工匠墓。

statement.zh: 吉萨三座金字塔分别属于第四王朝的胡夫、哈夫拉和门卡乌拉；胡夫的大金字塔最大，也最早。
statement.en: The three pyramids of Giza belong to the 4th-dynasty kings Khufu, Khafre and Menkaure; Khufu's Great Pyramid is the largest and oldest of the three.

sources.locator: Britannica, Pyramids of Giza, main text
sources.excerpt: The northernmost and oldest pyramid of the group was built for Khufu … The middle pyramid was built for Khafre … The southernmost and last pyramid to be built was that of Menkaure.

zh: 吉萨三座金字塔分别属于第四王朝的胡夫、哈夫拉和门卡乌拉；胡夫的大金字塔最大，也最早。
en: The three pyramids of Giza belong to the 4th-dynasty kings Khufu, Khafre and Menkaure; Khufu's Great Pyramid is the largest and oldest of the three.

note.zh: 三座归属与胡夫金字塔最大、最早照条目；不写“三座都是胡夫所建”。
note.en: Ownership and Khufu's largest/oldest status follow the entry; no claim that all three were Khufu's.

statement.zh: 胡夫大金字塔底边平均约230米，原高约147米，现高约138米。
statement.en: The Great Pyramid's base averages about 230 metres, its original height was about 147 metres, and it now stands about 138 metres.

sources.locator: Britannica, Pyramids of Giza, main text
sources.excerpt: The length of each side at the base averaging 755.75 feet (230 meters) and its original height being 481.4 feet (147 meters). … the Great Pyramid, for example, is now only 451.4 feet (138 meters) high.

zh: 胡夫大金字塔底边平均约230米，原高约147米，现高约138米。
en: The Great Pyramid's base averages about 230 metres, its original height was about 147 metres, and it now stands about 138 metres.

note.zh: 底边、原高、现高照条目；不写“精确到厘米”。
note.en: Base, original and current height follow the entry; no centimetre precision.

statement.zh: 胡夫金字塔约用230万块石头，总重约575万吨。
statement.en: Khufu's pyramid used about 2.3 million blocks of stone and weighs about 5.75 million tons.

sources.locator: Britannica, Pyramids of Giza, main text
sources.excerpt: Approximately 2.3 million blocks of stone were cut, transported, and assembled to create the 5.75-million-ton structure, which is a masterpiece of technical skill and engineering ability.

zh: 胡夫金字塔约用230万块石头，总重约575万吨。
en: Khufu's pyramid used about 2.3 million blocks of stone and weighs about 5.75 million tons.

note.zh: 块数与总重照条目；不写“每块重量一致”。
note.en: Block count and total weight follow the entry; no claim that every block weighed the same.

statement.zh: 希罗多德说大金字塔修了20年、用了10万人；现代考古研究提出可能少至约2万名工人，加上面包师、医生等支持人员。
statement.en: Herodotus says the Great Pyramid took 20 years and 100,000 men; modern archaeological research suggests as few as about 20,000 workers, plus support staff such as bakers and physicians.

sources.locator: Britannica, Pyramids of Giza, 'How did the Egyptians build the pyramids?'
sources.excerpt: According to the ancient Greek historian Herodotus the Great Pyramid took 20 years to construct and demanded the labor of 100,000 men. … It was suggested that as few as 20,000 workers, with accompanying support personnel (bakers, physicians, priests, etc.), would have been adequate for the task.

zh: 希罗多德说大金字塔修了20年、用了10万人；现代考古研究提出可能少至约2万名工人，加上面包师、医生等支持人员。
en: Herodotus says the Great Pyramid took 20 years and 100,000 men; modern archaeological research suggests as few as about 20,000 workers, plus support staff such as bakers and physicians.

note.zh: 两组数字分别标为古代叙述与考古推算；不合并成确定数字。
note.en: The two figures are marked as ancient narrative and archaeological estimate; they are not merged into one certain number.

statement.zh: 金字塔附近发现工人区，包括面包房、仓储、作坊和工匠的小墓。
statement.en: Workers' districts have been found near the pyramids, including bakeries, storage areas, workshops and the small tombs of artisans.

sources.locator: Britannica, Pyramids of Giza, excavations paragraph
sources.excerpt: In the late 1980s and ’90s, excavations in the environs of the pyramids revealed laborers’ districts that included bakeries, storage areas, workshops and the small tombs of workers and artisans.

zh: 金字塔附近发现工人区，包括面包房、仓储、作坊和工匠的小墓。
en: Workers' districts have been found near the pyramids, including bakeries, storage areas, workshops and the small tombs of artisans.

note.zh: 只写考古发现；不写“工人全是自由民”或“全是奴隶”。
note.en: Only the archaeological finds; no claim that all workers were free or all slaves.

statement.zh: 把金字塔写成“奴隶堆出来的”会错过真正的能力：采石、运输、口粮、测量和季节性劳役的组织。
statement.en: Writing the pyramids off as 'built by slaves' misses the real capacity: the organisation of quarrying, transport, rations, surveying and seasonal labour.

zh: 把金字塔写成“奴隶堆出来的”会错过真正的能力：采石、运输、口粮、测量和季节性劳役的组织。
en: Writing the pyramids off as 'built by slaves' misses the real capacity: the organisation of quarrying, transport, rations, surveying and seasonal labour.

note.zh: 作者判断：用组织能力替代“奴隶劳动力”单因解释。
note.en: Author judgment: replaces the single-cause 'slave labour' explanation with organisational capacity.

reasons.zh: 断言核验仍为机器摘录，待人工复核，不能升级
reasons.en: Claim verification is machine-extracted and cannot be promoted before human review

title.zh: 通往美索不达米亚：原料、砝码与海运贸易

summary.zh: 印度河城市的贸易网络延伸到美索不达米亚和中亚。进口原料进入本地作坊，成品再沿河与沿海路线分销；标准砝码和统一度量衡是跨区域交易的技术条件。具体港口与货物清单仍有争议。

statement.zh: 印度河城市的贸易网络延伸到美索不达米亚和中亚。
statement.en: The trade networks of the Indus cities reached Mesopotamia and Central Asia.

sources.excerpt: Trade was extensive and apparently well-regulated, providing imported raw materials for use at internal production centers, distributing finished goods throughout the region... establishing Harappan “colonies” in both Mesopotamia and Badakhshan.

zh: 印度河城市的贸易网络延伸到美索不达米亚和中亚。来自外地的原料进入本地作坊，成品再沿河与沿海路线分销；
en: The trade networks of the Indus cities reached Mesopotamia and Central Asia. Imported raw materials entered local workshops, and finished goods were distributed along river and coastal routes;

statement.zh: 标准砝码和统一度量衡，是这套交易能够跨区域运行的技术条件。
statement.en: Standard weights and uniform measures were the technical conditions for this cross-regional trade.

sources.excerpt: The remarkable uniformity of weights and measures throughout the Indus lands, as well as the development of such presumably civic works as the great granaries, implies a strong degree of political and administrative control over a wide area.

zh: 标准砝码和统一度量衡，是这套交易能够跨区域运行的技术条件。
en: standard weights and uniform measures were the technical conditions for this cross-regional trade.

statement.zh: 贸易的规模可以确认，具体的港口清单却不能。把某一件珠子或某一枚印章直接对应成一条固定航线，会把考古证据说得比它本身更确定。
statement.en: The scale of the trade can be established, but the specific list of ports cannot. Matching a single bead or a single seal directly to a fixed route makes the archaeological evidence sound more certain than it is.

zh: 贸易的规模可以确认，具体的港口清单却不能。把某一件珠子或某一枚印章直接对应成一条固定航线，会把考古证据说得比它本身更确定。
en: The scale of the trade can be established, but the specific list of ports cannot. Matching a single bead or a single seal directly to a fixed route makes the archaeological evidence sound more certain than it is.

statement.zh: 住宅围绕水井、浴室与排水沟组织。城内还有公共浴池、污水渗坑和大谷仓。
statement.en: Houses were organised around wells, bathrooms and drains. The city also had public baths, soak pits and a large granary.

sources.locator: Brief synthesis，公共设施与排水段

en: Houses in Mohenjo-daro were organised around wells, bathrooms and drains. The city also had public baths, soak pits and a large granary

statement.zh: 这些设施不是一户人家能独立维持的，需要城市级的清洁、供水与储存安排。
statement.en: These facilities could not be maintained by a single household and required city-level arrangements for cleaning, water supply and storage.

statement.zh: 日常生活的基础设施，比一座难以确认的“王宫”更能说明这座城市的组织能力。排水沟的坡度、井壁的砌法和垃圾坑的位置，都是可以重复检查的工程细节。
statement.en: Everyday infrastructure says more about the city's organisational capacity than an unconfirmed “palace”. The slope of a drain, the construction of a well shaft and the placing of a rubbish pit are engineering details that can be checked again and again.

title.zh: 努比亚库什王国前身Kerma文化兴起

summary.zh: 约公元前2500年，尼罗河上游（今苏丹北部）的Kerma文化成为非洲最早的城邦国家之一。Kerma建筑了巨大的泥砖神庙和防御工事（Deffufa），控制着通往非洲内陆的黄金、象牙和乌木贸易路线。Kerma与埃及古王国时期存在贸易往来，后成为埃及的主要竞争对手，最终在约前1500年被新王国埃及征服。

statement.zh: 约公元前2500年，尼罗河上游（今苏丹北部）的Kerma文化成为非洲最早的城邦国家之一。
statement.en: Around 2500 BCE, the Kerma culture in the upper Nile (modern northern Sudan) became one of the earliest urban states in Africa.

zh: 约公元前2500年，尼罗河上游（今苏丹北部）的Kerma文化成为非洲最早的城邦国家之一。
en: Around 2500 BCE, the Kerma culture in the upper Nile (modern northern Sudan) became one of the earliest urban states in Africa.

statement.zh: Kerma建筑了巨大的泥砖神庙和防御工事（Deffufa），控制着通往非洲内陆的黄金、象牙和乌木贸易路线。
statement.en: Kerma built huge mudbrick temples and fortifications (Deffufa), controlling trade routes for gold, ivory, and ebony into the African interior.

zh: Kerma建筑了巨大的泥砖神庙和防御工事（Deffufa），控制着通往非洲内陆的黄金、象牙和乌木贸易路线。

zh:
约公元前2500年，巨石阵进入中央石阵阶段。巨大的萨尔森石和较小的蓝石被竖立起来，形成外圈石柱与内部三石塔。建造需要许多人协作，完成运输、加工和竖立石块。

把「巨石阵巨石落成」放回公元前2500年的英格兰，它连接了建筑在长时段中的前后变化。
en: Around 2500 BCE Stonehenge entered its central stone phase. Large sarsen stones and smaller bluestones were raised to form an outer circle and inner trilithons. The work required many people to transport, shape and set the stones, and it tied the monument to a wider landscape of ceremonial use. Stonehenge became a place where astronomical alignments, ritual movement and collective labour came together. Its precise purpose remains debated, but the structure itself shows how prehistoric communities could coordinate large projects and mark time through the sky. The monument's later fame has made it a symbol of prehistory, even as scholars continue to test older assumptions about how and why it was built. Its stones still anchor debates about prehistoric engineering and belief.

title.zh: 中国良渚文化反山墓地出土玉琮王

summary.zh: 约公元前2600-2500年，良渚文化的反山墓地M12大墓出土了约6.5公斤的玉器，包括玉琮、玉璧、玉钺等礼器，其上雕刻有精细的神人兽面纹（神徽），体现了良渚社会高度发达的玉器工艺和统一的宗教信仰体系。反山墓地紧邻莫角山宫殿区，墓主应为良渚古国的最高统治者。

statement.zh: 约公元前2600-2500年，良渚文化的反山墓地M12大墓出土了约6.5公斤的玉器，包括玉琮、玉璧、玉钺等礼器，其上雕刻有精细的神人兽面纹（神徽），体现了良渚社会高度发达的玉器工艺和统一的宗教信仰体系。反山墓地紧邻莫角山宫殿区，墓主应为良渚古国的最高统治者。
statement.en:
Around 2600-2500 BCE, the Fan Mountain burial M12 of the Liangzhu culture yielded about 6.5 kg of jade artifacts, including cong tubes, bi discs, and yue axes, carved with fine spirit faces (divine emblems). This reflects the Liangzhu culture's highly developed jade craftsmanship and unified religious belief system. The Fan Mountain cemetery is adjacent to the Mojiaoshan palace area, and the tomb owner should be the highest ruler of the Liangzhu ancient state.

For Asia in 2500 BCE, “Fan Mountain burial yields jade cong king in Liangzhu culture, China” is a traceable node of Art change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 第五王朝建立，太阳神拉崇拜崛起

summary.zh: 约公元前2490年，第四王朝末王后继承权争导致第五王朝建立，创始人乌瑟卡夫（Userkaf）大大加强了拉神崇拜，在阿布西尔建造了第一座太阳神庙。法老的金字塔规模显著缩小，太阳神庙获得独立于法老陵墓的地位，祭司阶层权力膨胀。

statement.zh: 约公元前2490年，第四王朝末王后继承权争导致第五王朝建立，创始人乌瑟卡夫（Userkaf）大大加强了拉神崇拜，在阿布西尔建造了第一座太阳神庙。法老的金字塔规模显著缩小，太阳神庙获得独立于法老陵墓的地位，祭司阶层权力膨胀。
statement.en:
Around 2490 BCE, succession disputes at the end of the Fourth Dynasty led to the establishment of the Fifth Dynasty. Its founder Userkaf greatly strengthened the cult of Ra, building the first sun temple at Abusir. The size of pharaohs' pyramids decreased significantly, while sun temples gained independent status, and the power of the priesthood expanded.

For Africa in 2500 BCE, “Fifth Dynasty established, rise of sun god Ra worship” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 埃及第五王朝远征蓬特

summary.zh: 约公元前2450年，第五王朝法老萨胡拉（Sahure）派遣大型舰队经红海到达蓬特，带回了大量香料、没药和活长颈鹿。他在阿布西尔的金字塔壁画上详细描绘了这次远征，显示埃及海上力量的强大。

statement.en: Around 2450 BCE, Pharaoh Sahura of the Fifth Dynasty sent a large fleet to Punt via the Red Sea, bringing back a large amount of spices, myrrh and live giraffes.

title.zh: 卢加尔扎吉西统一苏美尔

summary.zh: 乌玛王卢加尔扎吉西攻占拉格什与乌鲁克，首次统一苏美尔诸城邦，旋为阿卡德萨尔贡所败。

statement.zh: 乌玛王卢加尔扎吉西攻占拉格什与乌鲁克，首次统一苏美尔诸城邦，旋为阿卡德萨尔贡所败。城邦之间的争霸以灌溉水道与贸易路线的控制为核心，统一带来了短暂的中央权威，却未能整合各城邦的地方势力。其失败使权力重心转向北方的阿卡德，苏美尔城邦时代由此走向终结。
statement.en: The Ummah king Lugalzaghis captured Lagash and Uruk and unified the Sumerian city-states for the first time, but was defeated by Sargon of Akkad.

title.zh: 萨尔贡的女儿恩赫杜安娜被任命为月神大祭司

summary.zh: 约公元前2330年，萨尔贡任命女儿恩赫杜安娜（Enheduanna，约公元前2285-2250年）为乌尔城月神南纳的大祭司。她是历史上第一位有名字的诗人，创作了多首献给伊南娜女神的赞美诗，开创了署名文学的先河。她的作品在美索不达米亚被传抄了千余年。

statement.en:
Around 2330 BCE, Sargon appointed his daughter Enheduanna (c. 2285-2250 BCE) as high priestess of the moon god Nanna at Ur. She is the first named poet in history, composing many hymns to the goddess Inanna, pioneering signed literature. Her works were copied in Mesopotamia for over a thousand years.

For Asia in 2334 BCE, “Sargon appoints his daughter Enheduanna as high priestess” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 阿姆斯伯里弓箭手下葬

summary.zh: 英格兰出现随葬铜斧与金饰的“钟杯文化”早期人物，显示远途迁徙与贵金属流通。

statement.zh:
英格兰出现随葬铜斧与金饰的“钟杯文化”早期人物，显示远途迁徙与贵金属流通。随葬的铜斧与金饰表明金属制品已进入墓葬的等级表达，器物的材质与形制又指向跨区域的技术与贸易网络；墓葬同时提示人口与观念在史前欧洲的远距离流动。

把「阿姆斯伯里弓箭手下葬」放回公元前2300年的英格兰，可以看到考古变化的一个具体切面。

statement.zh: 约公元前2240年，纳拉姆辛派军沿波斯湾南下，征服了马干（今阿曼地区），从而控制了波斯湾贸易和铜矿资源。马干以铜矿与海上贸易著称，控制其地可为两河流域提供金属与商路；远征结合军事征服与贸易据点，把阿卡德的影响伸向海湾。资源与交通是帝国扩张的动力。
statement.en: Around 2240 BCE, Naram-Sin sent his army south along the Persian Gulf and conquered Magan (present-day Oman), thus controlling the trade and copper resources of the Persian Gulf.

title.zh: 纳拉姆辛继位并自称四方之王

summary.zh: 约公元前2254年，玛尼什图舒之子纳拉姆辛（Naram-Sin）成为阿卡德最强大的君主。他彻底镇压各地叛乱，并自封为神。著名的纳拉姆辛胜利石碑刻画了他踏着敌人身躯登山的形象，收藏于卢浮宫。阿卡德帝国在纳拉姆辛统治时期达到最大版图，从地中海延伸到波斯湾。

title.zh: 埃及古王国时期结束，第一中间期开始

summary.zh: 约公元前2181年，佩皮二世死后埃及进入第一中间期（第7-11王朝前期）。尼罗河洪水连续多年偏低，导致大面积饥荒。南部底比斯和北部赫拉克利奥波利斯分别建立割据政权，双方爆发内战。

statement.en:
Around 2300-1900 BCE, the Shimao site in northern Shaanxi, China, began building large stone gates, with walls incorporating rhombic timber-reinforced construction. Shimao covers about 4 square kilometers, making it the largest city of its time in China. Numerous jade artifacts were embedded in the walls. Its discovery shows that this region already possessed early state formation.

For Asia in 2200 BCE, “Initial construction of Shimao site in China” is a traceable node of Engineering change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 赫梯人早期王国在安纳托利亚形成

summary.zh: 约公元前2200年，赫梯人（Hittites）在安纳托利亚中部的库萨拉和涅萨建立城邦，使用古亚述楔形文字记录。阿尼塔（Anitta）国王后来征服了整个安纳托利亚中部，留下最早的赫梯语铭文。赫梯文明是安纳托利亚最早的印欧语系文明。

title.zh: 阿卡德帝国衰落，古提人入侵

summary.zh: 约公元前2200年，纳拉姆辛晚年古提人（Guti）从扎格罗斯山侵入美索不达米亚，阿卡德帝国边境收缩，地方总督日益独立。纳拉姆辛死后，帝国迅速瓦解。古提人统治美索不达米亚约一个世纪，史称古提王朝。

statement.zh: 约公元前2200年，纳拉姆辛晚年古提人（Guti）从扎格罗斯山侵入美索不达米亚，阿卡德帝国边境收缩，地方总督日益独立。纳拉姆辛死后，帝国迅速瓦解。古提人统治美索不达米亚约一个世纪，史称古提王朝。
statement.en:
Around 2200 BCE, in the late years of Naram-Sin, the Gutians from the Zagros Mountains invaded Mesopotamia. The empire's borders contracted, and local governors became increasingly independent. After Naram-Sin's death, the empire quickly disintegrated. The Gutians ruled Mesopotamia for about a century, known as the Gutian dynasty.

For Asia in 2200 BCE, “Decline of Akkadian Empire, Gutian invasion” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 中国山西陶寺遗址观象台建立

summary.zh: 约公元前2300-1900年，黄河中游的陶寺文化在山西襄汾陶寺遗址建造了一座直径约40米的半圆形夯土观象台，设有13个观测柱缝，可通过观测日出裂缝确定节气与农时。陶寺观象台是迄今发现最早的实地观测天文台之一。

statement.zh: 约公元前2300-1900年，黄河中游的陶寺文化在山西襄汾陶寺遗址建造了一座直径约40米的半圆形夯土观象台，设有13个观测柱缝，可通过观测日出裂缝确定节气与农时。陶寺观象台是迄今发现最早的实地观测天文台之一。
statement.en:
Around 2300-1900 BCE, the Taosi culture in the middle Yellow River valley built a semicircular rammed-earth observatory about 40 meters in diameter at Taosi, Xiangfen, Shanxi. It had 13 observation notches that could determine the solstices and agricultural seasons by watching the sunrise. The Taosi observatory is the earliest known field astronomical observatory.

For Asia in 2200 BCE, “Construction of Taosi observatory in China” is a traceable node of Technology change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 埃及第十一王朝孟图霍特普二世开始统一战争

title.zh: 乌尔纳姆建立乌尔第三王朝

summary.zh: 约公元前2112年，乌尔总督乌尔纳姆（Ur-Nammu）击败乌鲁克，建立乌尔第三王朝（Ur III）。他颁布了世界上已知最早的成文法典——《乌尔纳姆法典》（Code of Ur-Nammu），以楔形文字刻写在泥板上，内容包括损害赔偿、婚姻家庭、奴隶管理等方面的规定，确立了以经济赔偿代替肉体惩罚的原则，比后来的汉谟拉比法典早约300年且更为人道。乌尔纳姆还在乌

statement.zh: 约公元前2112年，乌尔总督乌尔纳姆（Ur-Nammu）击败乌鲁克，建立乌尔第三王朝（Ur III）。他颁布了世界上已知最早的成文法典——《乌尔纳姆法典》（Code of Ur-Nammu），以楔形文字刻写在泥板上，内容包括损害赔偿、婚姻家庭、奴隶管理等方面的规定。确立了以经济赔偿代替肉体惩罚的原则，比后来的汉谟拉比法典早约300年且更为人道。乌尔纳姆还在乌尔城中心建造了供奉月亮神南纳的巨大三层塔庙（ziggurat），地基约62米乘43米。

summary.zh: 乌尔纳姆法典以苏美尔语楔形文字刻于石碑，规定刑罚、婚姻与奴隶等，是早于汉谟拉比法典的重要立法文献。

statement.zh: 乌尔纳姆法典以苏美尔语楔形文字刻于石碑，规定刑罚、婚姻与奴隶等事项，是早于《汉谟拉比法典》的重要立法文献。以石碑公布法律，意味着规范不再只依赖口头或临时裁决，而获得了可反复引用的固定文本；刑罚、婚姻与奴隶条款并列，也显示立法者试图把社会关系纳入统一秩序。
statement.en: The Code of Ur-Nammu was engraved on a stone tablet in Sumerian cuneiform and stipulated matters such as punishment, marriage, and slavery.

title.zh: 苏美尔历法与六十进制

summary.zh: 乌尔第三王朝时期巴比伦尼亚确立六十进制计数与早期历法，奠定天文与时间计量的基础。

statement.zh: 乌尔第三王朝时期巴比伦尼亚确立六十进制计数与早期历法，奠定天文与时间计量的基础。六十进制的优点在于可被多个约数整除，便于分数的表达与换算；它与月份、时角的划分结合后，形成便于天文观测与行政记账的计量习惯。历法以月相为基础，又以闰月调整与太阳年的偏差，体现出实用的观测取向。这套体系经后世沿用，成为时间与角度计量的来源之一。
statement.en: Under the Third Dynasty of Ur, Babylonia fixes the sexagesimal counting system and an early calendar, grounding astronomy and timekeeping.

statement.en: Base sixty is convenient because it divides evenly by many numbers, easing the expression and conversion of fractions; combined with the division of months and hours, it produced habits suited to astronomical observation and administrative accounting.

title.zh: 米诺斯文明早期宫殿建筑（古宫殿时期）

summary.zh: 约公元前1900年，克里特岛米诺斯文明进入旧宫殿时期（Protopalatial period）。克诺索斯、法伊斯托斯和马利亚等地的宫殿群陆续建成，这些宫殿围绕中央庭院布局，拥有多层建筑、仓库和供水系统。米诺斯人使用线形文字A（尚未破译）进行行政管理。米诺斯文明是欧洲最早的青铜时代文明，与埃及和中东保持活跃贸易。

statement.zh: 约公元前1900年，克里特岛米诺斯文明进入旧宫殿时期（Protopalatial period）。克诺索斯、法伊斯托斯和马利亚等地的宫殿群陆续建成，这些宫殿围绕中央庭院布局，拥有多层建筑、仓库和供水系统。米诺斯人使用线形文字A（尚未破译）进行行政管理。米诺斯文明是欧洲最早的青铜时代文明，与埃及和中东保持活跃贸易。
statement.en:
Around 1900 BCE, the Minoan civilization on Crete entered the Protopalatial period. Palace complexes at Knossos, Phaistos, and Malia were built. These palaces were arranged around a central court, with multiple stories, storage rooms, and water supply systems. The Minoans used Linear A script (undeciphered) for administration. The Minoan civilization was the earliest Bronze Age civilization in Europe and maintained active trade with Egypt and the Near East.

For Europe in 2094 BCE, “Early palace architecture of Minoan civilization (Old Palace period)” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

summary.zh: 相传在尧舜时期，黄河流域发生特大洪水。鲧治水失败后其子禹改用疏导之法，历时十三年，三过家门而不入，终于制服洪水。禹因治水功绩被舜选为继承人，最终建立了夏朝的分封基础。该事件反映了早期国家公共工程组织的雏形。

statement.zh: 传统说法认为在尧舜时期，黄河流域发生特大洪水。鲧治水失败后其子禹改用疏导之法，历时十三年，三过家门而不入，终于制服洪水。禹因治水功绩被舜选为继承人，最终建立了夏朝的分封基础。该事件反映了早期国家公共工程组织的雏形。
statement.en:
Legend has it that during the time of Yao and Shun, a great flood occurred in the Yellow River basin. Gun failed to control it, but his son Yu switched to a method of dredging and channeling. After thirteen years, passing his own door three times without entering, he finally subdued the floods. Because of his flood-control achievements, Yu was chosen by Shun as his successor, eventually establishing the enfeoffment foundation of the Xia Dynasty. This event reflects the embryonic form of early state public works organization.

statement.en:
According to the Records of the Grand Historian (Shiji) and the Xia-Shang-Zhou Chronology Project, around 2070 BCE, after Yu's death, his son Qi abolished the traditional abdication system and seized the throne by force, establishing the Xia Dynasty. This transformed Chinese history from 'public realm' to 'family realm', making the Xia the first hereditary dynasty in Chinese history. According to texts like the Bamboo Annals, the Xia Dynasty lasted for 14 generations and 17 kings, about 471 years. The existence of the Xia is associated archaeologically with the Erlitou culture (c. 1900-1500 BCE), but no direct written evidence has confirmed it.

For Asia in 2070 BCE, “Establishment of the Xia Dynasty” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.en:
During the reign of Taikang, the second ruler of the Xia Dynasty (son of Qi), he was decadent, ignoring state affairs and often hunting north of the Luo River for months. Hou Yi, a leader of the Youqiong tribe from the eastern Yi peoples, took the opportunity to seize power, and Taikang was forced into exile. This event is known as 'Taikang Loses the Throne'. Xia rule was interrupted for about forty years, known as 'Hou Yi Replaces Xia'.

For Asia in 2040 BCE, “Taikang loses the throne” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

zh:
印度河流域文明的衰落并不整齐。到公元前第二千纪中期，摩亨佐-达罗已经衰落；南部遗址可能延续得更久。

环境变化、河流改道、贸易网络重组和外来压力都可能参与，但没有任何一条能单独解释所有遗址。把衰落写成一次“文明灭亡”，会忽略不同城市在时间上的错位。
en:
The decline of the Indus civilisation was not uniform. By the middle of the second millennium BCE, Mohenjo-daro was already declining; southern sites may have lasted longer.

Environmental change, river shifts, the reorganisation of trade networks and outside pressure may all have played a part, but no single one explains every site. Writing the decline as one “civilisation destroyed” ignores the different timing of different cities.

statement.en:
Around 2004 BCE, during the reign of the last king Ibbi-Sin, Amorites invaded and Elam declared independence. The city of Ur was sacked by the Elamite army, and Ibbi-Sin was captured and taken to Elam. The Third Dynasty of Ur fell, and Mesopotamia entered the Isin-Larsa period.

For Asia in 2004 BCE, “Fall of the Third Dynasty of Ur” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 美索不达米亚伊辛王朝的利皮特·伊什塔法典

summary.zh: 约公元前1930年，伊辛王利皮特·伊什塔（Lipit-Ishtar）颁布了一部法典，比《乌尔纳姆法典》更为详细，涉及婚姻、继承和奴隶权利等内容，用苏美尔语写在泥板上。该法典是研究古代西亚法律演变的重要文献。

statement.zh: 约公元前1930年，伊辛王利皮特·伊什塔颁布了一部法典，比《乌尔纳姆法典》更为详细，涉及婚姻、继承和奴隶权利等内容，用苏美尔语写在泥板上。与较早法典相比，它把婚姻、继承与奴隶权利放在同一部文本中，说明立法关注点已从单纯刑罚扩展到日常社会关系的安排；泥板载体也让文本更便于保存与传抄。
statement.en: Around 1930 BCE, King Lipit Ishtar of Isin promulgated a code that was more detailed than the Ur-Nammu Code, covering matters such as marriage, inheritance, and slave rights.

title.zh: 拉尔萨在埃兰人支持下独立崛起

summary.zh: 约公元前2001年，拉尔萨国王纳普拉努姆（Naplanum）在埃兰人支持下巩固独立地位，开始在苏美尔南部扩张势力，与伊辛王朝争夺两河流域霸权。拉尔萨的兴起标志着伊辛-拉尔萨时期的正式形成。两河流域进入长达两个多世纪的伊辛与拉尔萨争霸时代。

statement.en: Around 2001 BCE, Larsa king Naplanum consolidated his independence with Elamite support and began to expand in southern Sumer, competing with the Isin dynasty for hegemony in Mesopotamia.

title.zh: 埃及第十一王朝衰落，第十二王朝建立

summary.zh: 约公元前1985年，第十一王朝末代法老孟图霍特普四世在位时，底比斯地方势力再次抬头，中央财政枯竭。他被谋杀后，维齐尔阿蒙涅姆赫特一世（Amenemhat I）建立第十二王朝，迁都伊特塔维（位于法尤姆附近），巩固边防并加强对努比亚的控制。第十二王朝是中王国最繁荣的时期。

statement.en: Around 1985 BCE, during the reign of the last Eleventh Dynasty pharaoh Mentuhotep IV, Theban local power rose again and central finances dried up.

title.zh: 夏朝仲康、相继位与后羿专权

summary.zh: 太康失国后，其弟仲康在部分夏朝贵族的拥立下自称夏王，但实权被后羿控制。仲康不甘做傀儡，派胤侯征讨后羿党羽失败，忧愤而死。其子相继续流亡，投靠同姓诸侯斟鄩氏和斟灌氏。夏朝中央权力进一步衰落。

title.zh: 中美洲最早小规模农业村落出现（约公元前2000年）

statement.zh:

title.zh: 印度河流域文明哈拉帕文化走向衰微

title.zh: 夏朝君主夏相在位（据后世文献追述）

summary.zh: 据《竹书纪年》《史记》等后世文献（约东周至汉代成书）记载，夏朝君主夏相在位期间，夏王朝处于"太康失国"后的动荡时期。东夷有穷氏首领后羿一度掌控夏政，夏相被迫迁往帝丘。此时期夏朝王权严重削弱，诸侯叛离。学界对夏朝年代尚未找到同时期文字确证，目前主要依据二里头文化（约-1900~-1500）的考古发现进行推定。

statement.en:
According to later texts such as the Bamboo Annals and Records of the Grand Historian (compiled from the Eastern Zhou to Han dynasties), during the reign of Xia Xiang, the Xia dynasty was in turmoil following 'Taikang's loss of the throne'. The Youqiong tribal leader Hou Yi controlled Xia politics, forcing Xia Xiang to move to Diqiu. Royal power was severely weakened, and vassals rebelled. Academic dating of the Xia relies on archaeological findings of the Erlitou culture (c. 1900–1500 BCE), as no contemporaneous writing has yet confirmed the dynasty's chronology.

For Asia in 2000 BCE, “Xia Dynasty ruler Xia Xiang reigns (as recorded in later texts)” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 阿蒙涅姆赫特一世建立埃及第十二王朝

title.zh: 埃及中王国时期全面繁荣

summary.zh: 经过阿蒙涅姆赫特一世及塞索斯特里斯一世的治理，第十二王朝进入全面繁荣。法老加强了对努比亚的控制，修建军事要塞（布亨、库马），开发法尤姆地区水利工程，将沼泽变为良田，经济文化达到中王国顶峰。

statement.zh: 经过阿蒙涅姆赫特一世及塞索斯特里斯一世的治理，第十二王朝进入全面繁荣。法老加强了对努比亚的控制，修建军事要塞（布亨、库马），开发法尤姆地区水利工程，将沼泽变为良田，经济文化达到中王国顶峰。
statement.en:
Under the governance of Amenemhat I and Senusret I, the Twelfth Dynasty entered full prosperity. Pharaohs strengthened control over Nubia, built military fortresses (Buhen, Kumma), and developed irrigation works in the Fayyum region, turning swamps into fertile fields. Economy and culture reached the peak of the Middle Kingdom.

For Africa in 1925 BCE, “Full Prosperity of Egypt's Middle Kingdom” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 中国二里头文化开始兴盛

summary.zh: 二里头文化（约公元前1900-1500年）在黄河中游河谷兴起，以河南偃师二里头遗址为代表。该遗址发现大型夯土宫殿基址、青铜冶铸作坊和绿松石龙形器，多数中国学者将其与夏朝中晚期都城相联系，但尚无同时期文字确证。二里头是中国最早进入青铜时代的国家形态社会之一。

statement.zh: 二里头文化（约公元前1900-1500年）在黄河中游河谷兴起，以河南偃师二里头遗址为代表。该遗址发现大型夯土宫殿基址、青铜冶铸作坊和绿松石龙形器，多数中国学者将其与夏朝中晚期都城相联系，但尚无同时期文字确证。二里头是中国最早进入青铜时代的国家形态社会之一。
statement.en:
The Erlitou culture (c. 1900–1500 BCE) arose in the middle Yellow River valley, represented by the Erlitou site in Yanshi, Henan. The site features large rammed-earth palace foundations, bronze-casting workshops, and a turquoise-inlaid dragon-shaped artifact. Most Chinese scholars associate it with the middle to late Xia dynasty, though no contemporaneous writing confirms this. Erlitou represents one of China's earliest state-level bronze-age societies.

For Asia in 1900 BCE, “Erlitou Culture Flourishes in China” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 少康复国（据后世文献追述）

summary.zh: 据《左传》《史记》等战国至汉代文献追述：少康盟军发动总攻，伯靡率军击败寒浞主力收复旧都斟鄩，少康在过国歼灭寒浇军队。寒浞被擒获处死，历经数十年流亡的少康恢复夏朝统治，史称"少康中兴"。少康定都纶邑，重建统治体系。此叙事年代约为公元前19世纪前后，与二里头文化中期大致对应。

statement.zh: 据《左传》《史记》等战国至汉代文献追述：少康盟军发动总攻，伯靡率军击败寒浞主力收复旧都斟鄩，少康在过国歼灭寒浇军队。寒浞被擒获处死，历经数十年流亡的少康恢复夏朝统治，史称"少康中兴"。少康定都纶邑，重建统治体系。此叙事年代约为公元前19世纪前后，与二里头文化中期大致对应。
statement.en:
According to later texts such as Zuo Zhuan and Records of the Grand Historian (compiled from Warring States to Han): Shaokang's allied forces launched a general offensive. Bomi's army defeated Han Zhuo's main force and recaptured the old capital Zhenxun. Shaokang's troops annihilated Han Jiao's army in the Guo state. Han Zhuo was captured and executed. After decades of exile, Shaokang restored Xia rule, known as the 'Shaokang Restoration'. He established the capital at Lunyi and rebuilt the governance system. This narrative corresponds roughly to the mid-19th century BCE, around the middle phase of Erlitou culture.

title.zh: 巴比伦第一王朝（阿摩利人）立国

summary.zh: 阿摩利人首领苏姆阿布姆（Sumu-abum）建立巴比伦城邦，史称巴比伦第一王朝。起初巴比伦仅控制城郭及周边几十公里，面临拉尔萨、埃什努纳等强邻威胁，但优越的地理位置为其日后崛起奠定基础。

statement.zh: 阿摩利人首领苏姆阿布姆（Sumu-abum）建立巴比伦城邦，史称巴比伦第一王朝。起初巴比伦仅控制城郭及周边几十公里，面临拉尔萨、埃什努纳等强邻威胁，但优越的地理位置为其日后崛起奠定基础。
statement.en:
Amorite leader Sumu-abum founded the city-state of Babylon, beginning the First Dynasty of Babylon. Initially, Babylon controlled only the city and a few dozen kilometers of surrounding territory, facing threats from powerful neighbors like Larsa and Eshnunna. However, its favorable location laid the foundation for its future rise.

For Asia in 1894 BCE, “First Dynasty of Babylon (Amorite) Established” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 中亚草原安德罗诺沃文化兴起

title.zh: 汉谟拉比成为古巴比伦国王

summary.zh: 汉谟拉比（Hammurabi）继承巴比伦王位。他一上台就面临严峻挑战：拉尔萨的里姆辛一世虎视眈眈，埃什努纳也不断挑衅。汉谟拉比展示卓越政治智慧，称臣于拉尔萨以争取发展时间，同时积极修筑城墙、整顿军备、修建贯通全国的运河，为日后的统一战争奠定物质基础。

title.zh: 汉谟拉比去世，巴比伦帝国由盛转衰

summary.zh: 汉谟拉比在位约42年后去世，继任者萨姆苏伊鲁纳（Samsu-iluna）缺乏其父的雄才大略。南部苏美尔地区爆发大规模叛乱，伊鲁马-伊鲁姆在海地地区建立第一海地王朝（巴比伦第二王朝），巴比伦丧失通往波斯湾的出海口和重要税收来源，帝国疆域急剧萎缩。

statement.zh: 汉谟拉比在位约42年后去世，继任者萨姆苏伊鲁纳（Samsu-iluna）缺乏其父的雄才大略。南部苏美尔地区爆发大规模叛乱，伊鲁马-伊鲁姆在海地地区建立第一海地王朝（巴比伦第二王朝），巴比伦丧失通往波斯湾的出海口和重要税收来源，帝国疆域急剧萎缩。
statement.en:
After a reign of about 42 years, Hammurabi died. His successor, Samsu-iluna, lacked his father's capabilities. Large-scale rebellions broke out in the Sumerian south. Iluma-ilum established the First Sealand Dynasty (Second Dynasty of Babylon) in the marshlands, causing Babylon to lose access to the Persian Gulf and significant tax revenues. The empire's territory shrank dramatically.

For Asia in 1750 BCE, “Hammurabi Dies, Babylonian Empire Declines” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

zh: 卢浮宫所藏《汉谟拉比法典》石碑以黑色玄武岩刻成，高约2.25米。铭文刻于约公元前1750年，汇集近280条司法判决，并非现代意义的法典。1902年，石碑在伊朗苏萨的法国考古发掘中被发现。它是在刻成几个世纪后被埃兰国王舒特鲁克-纳洪特作为战利品带到苏萨的。石碑自1904年起在卢浮宫展出。
en: The Hammurabi stele in the Louvre is carved from black basalt and stands about 2.25 metres high. Its inscription was cut around 1750 BCE and gathers nearly 280 judicial decisions. The text is conventionally called a code, but it is better understood as a collection of ancient legal decisions than as a modern comprehensive statute book. French excavations at Susa, in Iran, found the stele in 1902. It had been carried there centuries after it was made, as war booty, by the Elamite king Shutruk-Nahhunte. The Louvre has displayed it since 1904. The stele matters both as a legal record and as an object whose journey shows how monuments are moved, reused and given new meanings over time, and how law itself can be tied to a physical object.

summary.zh: 北美路易斯安那的 波弗蒂角 建成六道同心土脊与图腾丘，为远古工程奇观。

statement.zh: 北美路易斯安那的波弗蒂角建成六道同心土脊与图腾丘，为远古工程奇观。土脊层层套叠，工程依靠人力搬运大量泥土完成，说明当时以狩猎采集为生的社群已能组织长期、大规模的集体劳作。这类土构通常与季节性的集会、祭祀和交换活动相关，它的存在也提示北美史前社会并非只有简单的流动群体。

title.zh: 希克索斯人在埃及北部建立第十五王朝

summary.zh: 来自迦南的闪米特人群希克索斯人（意为"外国统治者"）以阿瓦里斯（Avaris）为中心建立第十五王朝。他们在此前一两个世纪已逐步迁入三角洲，利用第十三王朝衰落之际夺权。希克索斯人将马匹、双轮战车、复合弓和青铜剑等先进军事装备引入埃及，改变了古埃及的战争形态。上埃及以底比斯为中心由第十七王朝统治，形成南北对峙。

title.zh: 商族兴起，成汤势力初具雏形

title.zh: 赫梯国王哈图西里一世统一安纳托利亚

summary.zh: 赫梯王国以楔形文刻立法典，规范刑法、婚姻与奴隶，反映安纳托利亚早期成文法。

statement.zh: 赫梯王国以楔形文刻立法典，规范刑法、婚姻与奴隶，反映安纳托利亚早期成文法。法典多以具体案例列举规范，赔偿与刑罚并用，处理人身伤害、家庭关系与财产纠纷；条文也透露多族群社会中习惯与王权的结合。成文法典使赫梯的司法与行政有据可依，是研究古代近东法律的重要材料。
statement.en: The Hittite Kingdom established a code of law in cuneiform script to standardize criminal law, marriage, and slaves, reflecting the early written laws of Anatolia.

statement.zh: 锡拉岛（Thera，今圣托里尼）发生VEI 6-7级的毁灭性火山喷发，喷发导致岛中心塌陷形成巨大火山口。火山灰覆盖整个东地中海，引发高达数十米的海啸摧毁了克里特岛北部沿海的米诺斯宫殿和港口，导致米诺斯文明遭受致命打击。此事件可能成为柏拉图记述的"亚特兰蒂斯"传说的历史原型。放射性碳定年约为公元前1627-1600年（Friedrich et al. 2006 Science）。
statement.en:
A devastating VEI 6-7 volcanic eruption occurred on Thera (modern Santorini). The eruption caused the center of the island to collapse, forming a huge caldera. Volcanic ash covered the entire eastern Mediterranean, and tsunamis tens of meters high destroyed Minoan palaces and harbors on the northern coast of Crete, dealing a fatal blow to Minoan civilization. This event may be the historical prototype for Plato's account of Atlantis. Radiocarbon dating gives around 1627–1600 BCE (Friedrich et al. 2006 Science).

In 1620 BCE, “Massive Volcanic Eruption on Thera (Santorini)” belongs to the field of Disaster in Europe.

For Europe in 1620 BCE, “Massive Volcanic Eruption on Thera (Santorini)” is a traceable node of Disaster change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 赫梯帝国掌握铁器冶炼技术

summary.zh: 赫梯人在安纳托利亚最先掌握先进的块炼铁技术，能通过多次锻打和渗碳制造硬度远超青铜的武器（铁剑、铁矛头）。赫梯帝国长期对铁器技术实行严格垄断，铁器成为赫梯王室赠送给埃及法老的珍贵外交礼物。

statement.zh: 赫梯人在安纳托利亚最先掌握先进的块炼铁技术，能通过多次锻打和渗碳制造硬度远超青铜的武器（铁剑、铁矛头）。赫梯帝国长期对铁器技术实行严格垄断，铁器成为赫梯王室赠送给埃及法老的珍贵外交礼物。
statement.en: The Hittites in Anatolia were the first to master advanced bloomery iron smelting, producing weapons (iron swords, iron spearheads) with hardness far exceeding bronze through repeated forging and carburization.

title.zh: 迈锡尼竖穴墓与巨石城门

summary.zh: 希腊伯罗奔尼撒的迈锡尼以 竖穴墓与独眼巨人石墙闻名，为迈锡尼文明中心。

statement.zh:
希腊伯罗奔尼撒的迈锡尼以竖穴墓与独眼巨人石墙闻名，为迈锡尼文明中心。竖穴墓中的随葬品显示这里与地中海东部存在联系，巨石城门与城墙则体现防御与王权的结合；墓葬、宫殿与防御工事集中在同一地点，说明迈锡尼的权势以祭祀、军事和行政相互支撑。

title.zh: 鸣条之战：成汤灭夏，商朝建立

summary.zh: 商汤率领商部落联盟与夏桀军队在鸣条（今河南洛阳附近）展开决战。夏军士气低落阵前倒戈，商军一举击溃夏军主力。夏桀战败后逃往南巢而死。成汤在亳邑（今河南商丘）举行祭天大典宣告商朝建立。商朝是目前中国第一个有同时期文字（甲骨文）直接证实的朝代。

statement.zh:
赫梯人定都哈图沙（今博阿兹卡莱），筑巨石城门与神庙，成为安纳托利亚强国中心。都城依山而建，城墙与城门以巨石砌筑，神庙与宫殿并置；其位置控制安纳托利亚中部的高原通道，便于对外征伐与行政。都城遗址的发现也让赫梯文献与制度得以被后世解读。

title.zh: 赫梯帝国兴起于安纳托利亚

summary.zh: 赫梯人在哈图沙建立强国，使用印欧语并掌握战车，成为青铜时代中后期与小亚细亚和叙利亚争霸的霸主。

statement.zh:
赫梯人在哈图沙建立强国，使用印欧语并掌握战车，成为青铜时代中后期与小亚细亚和叙利亚争霸的霸主。王国以都城为中心，靠条约、联姻与军事远征维系对周边城邦的控制；战车部队与铁器技术是其军事优势。与埃及的争霸最终以条约收场。

把「赫梯帝国兴起于安纳托利亚」放回公元前1600年的安纳托利亚，可以看到政治变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: The Hittites established a strong state in Hattusa, spoke the Indo-European language and mastered chariots, becoming the overlords competing with Asia Minor and Syria in the middle and late Bronze Age.

title.zh: 加喜特人占领巴比伦建立第三王朝

title.zh: 雅赫摩斯与希克索斯：新王国的军事财政

summary.zh: 雅赫摩斯一世约前1539–前1514在位，创立第十八王朝，完成驱逐希克索斯人：攻占阿瓦里斯、追到沙鲁亨围城三年，并三次进军努比亚。随后恢复行政、给老兵授地、重开铜矿与贸易。旧稿“建立常备军”删去。

statement.zh: 雅赫摩斯一世约在前1539–前1514年在位，是第十八王朝的创立者，完成了对希克索斯人的驱逐。
statement.en: Ahmose I reigned c. 1539–1514 BCE, founded the 18th dynasty and completed the expulsion of the Hyksos.

sources.excerpt: Ahmose I, was king of ancient Egypt (reigned c. 1539–14 bce) and founder of the 18th dynasty who completed the expulsion of the Hyksos (Asiatic rulers of Egypt).

zh: 雅赫摩斯一世约在前1539–前1514年在位，是第十八王朝的创立者，完成了对希克索斯人的驱逐。
en: Ahmose I reigned c. 1539–1514 BCE, founded the 18th dynasty and completed the expulsion of the Hyksos.

statement.en: He captured the Hyksos capital of Avaris, pursued the enemy to Sharuhen in Palestine, and took it after a three-year siege.

sources.excerpt: Having put down the rising, he captured Avaris and then pursued the enemy to Sharuhen, a Hyksos stronghold in Palestine, which was reduced after a three-year siege.

statement.zh: 边疆稳定后，他建立效忠自己的行政体系，给老兵和王室成员土地，并恢复西奈铜矿与叙利亚沿海贸易。
statement.en: After his borders were secure, he established an administration loyal to him, granted land to veterans and members of the royal family, and reopened the copper mines of Sinai and trade with the Syrian coast.

sources.excerpt: After his borders were secure, Ahmose established an administration loyal to him in Egypt and granted lands to distinguished veterans of his campaigns and to members of the royal family. He reactivated the copper mines at Sinai and resumed trade with the cities of the Syrian coast.

title.zh: 商朝开国君主商汤去世，太甲继位

summary.zh: 据《史记》记载（殷墟甲骨文亦印证部分商王世系）：商汤去世后其孙太甲继位。太甲初期昏庸无道，被四朝元老伊尹放逐到桐宫反省，三年后悔过复位。太甲复位后勤政爱民，商朝国力恢复，史称"太宗"。这是中国历史上最早的王权被权臣制约的记录。

statement.zh: 据《史记》记载（殷墟甲骨文亦印证部分商王世系）：商汤去世后其孙太甲继位。太甲初期昏庸无道，被四朝元老伊尹放逐到桐宫反省，三年后悔过复位。太甲复位后勤政爱民，商朝国力恢复，史称"太宗"。这是中国历史上最早的王权被权臣制约的记录。
statement.en:
According to the Records of the Grand Historian (partially corroborated by Shang oracle bone inscriptions), Tang of Shang died and his grandson Tai Jia succeeded. Initially, Tai Jia was incompetent and debauched; the veteran minister Yi Yin exiled him to Tong Palace for reflection. After three years, Tai Jia repented and was restored. He then governed diligently, and Shang power recovered. He was posthumously honored as 'Tai Zong'. This is the earliest recorded instance of royal power being checked by a minister in Chinese history.

For Asia in 1550 BCE, “Tang of Shang Dies, Tai Jia Succeeds the Throne” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

He then governed diligently, and Shang power recovered. He was posthumously honored as 'Tai Zong'. This is the earliest recorded instance of royal power being checked by a minister in Chinese history.

title.zh: 《埃伯斯纸卷》：经验、咒语与解剖同在一卷

summary.zh: 《埃伯斯纸草卷》约前1550年成书，是已知最古老医学作品之一；约700个魔法配方和民间疗法，从鳄鱼咬伤到脚趾甲疼痛，并有较准确的循环系统描述。1873年由埃伯斯购得。旧稿“877个处方、癌症诊断”删去。

statement.zh: 《埃伯斯纸草卷》约成书于前1550年，是已知最古老的医学作品之一。
statement.en: The Ebers Papyrus was compiled about 1550 BCE and is one of the oldest known medical works.

sources.excerpt: Ebers papyrus, Egyptian compilation of medical texts dated about 1550 bc, one of the oldest known medical works.

zh: 《埃伯斯纸草卷》约成书于前1550年，是已知最古老的医学作品之一。
en: The Ebers Papyrus was compiled about 1550 BCE and is one of the oldest known medical works.

statement.en: It contains about 700 magical formulas and folk remedies, ranging from crocodile bite to toenail pain and including ways to rid a house of flies, rats and scorpions.

en: It contains about 700 magical formulas and folk remedies, ranging from crocodile bite to toenail pain and including ways to rid a house of flies, rats and scorpions.

title.zh: 埃及法老雅赫摩斯一世去世，阿蒙霍特普一世继位

summary.zh: 雅赫摩斯一世去世后其子阿蒙霍特普一世（Amenhotep I）继位，继续向南远征努比亚至大瀑布附近，向西进入利比亚巩固西部边界。他在底比斯为卡纳克神庙增建建筑，开启了新王国时期大规模神庙建设的传统。

statement.zh: 雅赫摩斯一世去世后其子阿蒙霍特普一世（Amenhotep I）继位，继续向南远征努比亚至大瀑布附近，向西进入利比亚巩固西部边界。他在底比斯为卡纳克神庙增建建筑，开启了新王国时期大规模神庙建设的传统。
statement.en:
After the death of Ahmose I, his son Amenhotep I succeeded. He continued military campaigns south into Nubia as far as the great river bend and west into Libya to secure the western borders. In Thebes, he added to the Karnak temple complex, beginning the tradition of large-scale temple construction in the New Kingdom period.

For Africa in 1525 BCE, “Egyptian Pharaoh Ahmose I Dies, Amenhotep I Succeeds” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 印度-雅利安人进入印度

summary.zh: 印度-雅利安语族群约前1500年自西北进入印度次大陆，带来《梨俱吠陀》与火祭、种姓之雏形，开启Vedic 文化，并逐步与本地文明融合。

statement.zh: 印度-雅利安语族群约前1500年自西北进入印度次大陆，带来《梨俱吠陀》与火祭、种姓之雏形，开启Vedic 文化，并逐步与本地文明融合。迁徙以部族与畜牧业为基础，祭祀与颂诗维系群体认同；与土著社会的接触催生了新的社会分层。次大陆的语言与宗教格局由此改写。
statement.en: The Indo-Aryan speaking people entered the Indian subcontinent from the northwest about 1500 BCE, bringing with them the Rig Veda, fire rituals, and the prototype of castes, starting Vedic culture and gradually integrating with local civilization.

title.zh: 尼日利亚诺克文化开始

summary.zh: 约公元前1500-公元500年，尼日利亚中部的诺克文化（Nok Culture）繁荣。诺克人以精湛的赤陶雕塑闻名，制作了真人大小的人头和动物雕像，是撒哈拉以南非洲最古老的雕塑传统之一。诺克人已使用铁器（约前500年），从事农业和贸易。诺克文化对后来的约鲁巴和贝宁艺术产生了深远影响。

title.zh: 拉皮塔文化：波利尼西亚人的祖先

summary.zh: 约公元前1500-500年，拉皮塔文化（Lapita Culture）在俾斯麦群岛（今巴布亚新几内亚）形成并迅速扩张至太平洋西南部。拉皮塔人以精美的齿印纹陶器闻名，是第一批定居斐济、汤加和萨摩亚的南岛语系人群。他们是现代波利尼西亚人、密克罗尼西亚人和部分美拉尼西亚人的直接祖先。拉皮塔人是历史上最伟大的航海民族，在短短数个世纪内穿越了太平洋数千公里的海域。

summary.zh: 湖北黄陂盘龙城是早期商文化南下长江的据点，城墙、宫殿与贵族墓显示商势力已达江汉。

statement.zh:
湖北黄陂盘龙城是早期商文化南下长江的据点，城墙、宫殿与贵族墓显示商势力已达江汉。城墙提供防御，宫殿与贵族墓则把商人的政治等级与埋葬习俗带到长江中游；三者共存说明这并非短暂的军事前哨，而是带有完整统治结构的聚落。

把「盘龙城商代城址」放回公元前1500年的商，可以看到文化变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Panlongcheng in Huangpi, Hubei, was an early Shang outpost reaching the Yangtze; its walls, palace and elite tombs show that Shang power had reached the Jianghan plain.

title.zh: 图特摩斯三世扩张帝国

summary.zh: 图特摩斯三世在麦吉多以北大败迦南联军，此后多年远征叙利亚巴勒斯坦，使埃及成为地跨北非西亚的帝国。

statement.zh:
图特摩斯三世在麦吉多以北大败迦南联军，此后多年远征叙利亚巴勒斯坦，使埃及成为地跨北非西亚的帝国。他亲率军队穿越险隘，出其不意地攻击联军集结地；战后以驻军、贡赋与地方代理人维持统治。远征记录刻于神庙墙面，成为研究埃及军事与地理的重要材料。

把「图特摩斯三世扩张帝国」放回公元前1479年的埃及，可以看到军事变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Thutmose III defeated the Canaanite coalition north of Megiddo.

statement.zh: 埃及底比斯的卡纳克神庙群约前14世纪起在阿蒙神名下大规模增建，以134根巨柱撑起的多柱厅与林立方尖碑著称，工程绵延1000年，是古埃及宗教与王权的核心圣地。历代法老以塔门、柱厅与圣所层层增筑，浮雕与铭文记录战功与祭祀；阿蒙的神谕与节庆吸引朝圣与献纳。
statement.en:
The Karnak Temple complex in Thebes, Egypt, was built on a large scale in the name of the god Amun starting around the 14th century BC. It is famous for its multi-column hall supported by 134 giant pillars and a series of obelisks. The project lasted for thousands of years and was the core holy place of ancient Egyptian religion and royal power. Pharaohs of all dynasties built towers, pillared halls and sanctuaries layer by layer, with reliefs and inscriptions recording military exploits and sacrifices; Amun's oracles and festivals attracted pilgrims and offerings.

It sits within the timeline's chronological coverage of Egypt and architecture history.

The entry is kept as a concise record of that wider process rather than a standalone narrative.

title.zh: 乌加里特字母文字诞生

summary.zh: 叙利亚沿海城邦乌加里特创制楔形字母文字，约三十个符号，是字母文字发展的重要里程碑。

statement.zh: 叙利亚沿海城邦乌加里特创制楔形字母文字，约三十个符号，是字母文字发展的重要里程碑。这种文字借用楔形泥板的书写方式，却只用少量符号表示辅音，因而比象形与音节文字更易学习；城邦的档案与神话文本以它记录，说明字母已能承担文学与行政的写作。字母化的思路后来经地中海东岸传播，成为后世字母传统的远源。
statement.en: The coastal Syrian city-state of Ugarit creates a cuneiform alphabetic script of about thirty signs, a milestone in the development of alphabets.

title.zh: 奥尔梅克文明：中美洲母文明

summary.zh: 约公元前1400-400年，奥尔梅克文明（Olmec Civilization）在墨西哥湾沿岸（今韦拉克鲁斯和塔巴斯科）繁荣。奥尔梅克人建造了巨大的玄武岩人头雕像（高约3米，重达20-50吨），发明中美洲历法和文字雏形，崇拜美洲虎神和羽蛇神。圣洛伦索（San Lorenzo）和拉文塔（La Venta）是其政治和宗教中心。奥尔梅克文明被公认为中美洲文化的"母

statement.en: From roughly 1400 to 400 BCE, the Olmec civilization flourished along the Gulf Coast of Mexico (present‑day Veracruz and Tabasco).

sources.excerpt: The population reached its peak numbers around 400 to 500 CE.
